## ADR-0050: Phase-19 xDS-family continuation — file-based LDS (`dynamic_resources.lds_config.path_config_source`), initial-load-only; chosen over CDS file watching (three stacked risks), file-based RDS/EDS (more schema surgery), and the still-blocked gRPC family; completes Envoy's canonical LDS+CDS filesystem-dynamic-config topology; defer file watching (with strictly improved ROI), RDS/EDS/SDS/RTDS, multi-listener spawning, and the gRPC/ADS transport

- **Date:** 2026-06-03.
- **Status:** accepted.
- **Context:** Phase 19 is the first phase after the xDS / dynamic config family opened (phase 18, `18-xds-file-based-cds`, closed at `2044a6bf5`). Per the phase-18 close-out (STATE.md `## Next expected skill` at that HEAD), this brainstorm weighs the candidates on the established axes (foundation reuse; differential testability under the timing-robustness doctrine; architectural risk; §9 charter coverage; whether the OPEN ADR-0028 deferral is engaged) — **no phase was pre-picked**; the xDS family's nominal prime follow-up (CDS file watching/hot reload) was explicitly to be weighed against the other §9 families on the merits. Method: cold-start artifact reads + ONE read-only `Explore` subagent survey of the candidate code surfaces at HEAD `2044a6bf5` (serial dispatch per `feedback_serial_subagent_dispatch`) + controller cross-checks of the load-bearing claims by direct grep/read (the fuzz-corpus count [29, correcting the survey's miscount of 30]; the `listeners.first()` single-listener spawn at `crates/envoy-bin/src/main.rs:216`; the zero-static-listeners validity gate at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:1939`; the fixture-0011 `listener_manager.*` allow-list at `tests/fixtures/0011-admin-stats-prometheus/expectations.yaml:213-224`; the unconditional `listener_manager.total_listeners_active` registration at `crates/envoy-listener/src/lib.rs:184-186`).
- **Options considered:**
  - **(a) CDS file watching / hot reload + the `ClusterManager` mutability refactor** (the ledger's nominal prime follow-up, heading the ADR-0048 §4 deferral list). **Rejected for phase 19 — three stacked risks:** (1) the `ClusterManager` mutability refactor is a genuinely large architectural lift — the survey confirmed `ClusterManager` remains immutable post-construction with three `Arc<ClusterManager>` holders (`envoy-http1` HCM at `hcm.rs:114`, `envoy-admin` at `handler.rs:57`, `envoy-health` at `scheduler.rs:42`) plus the pool managers and `OutlierManager`; runtime cluster add/update/remove additionally needs cluster warming, pool draining for removed clusters, and health/outlier-task lifecycle management — a guaranteed multi-sub-phase split; (2) a file-watch differential fixture is inherently timing-sensitive (write file → watch fires → convergence window → assert), cutting against the timing-robustness doctrine every phase since 15 has been anchored on; (3) **the §6.2 verify-at-PLAN-write discipline cannot run for this phase in the local environment** — ADR-0049's Provenance records that Envoy's inotify-based file watching is unobservable under macOS Docker Desktop (virtiofs limitation; the phase-18 §6.2 item 11 was INCONCLUSIVE); the watch phase's §6.2 verification must be redesigned to run on Linux CI before that phase can be planned. **Additionally, deferring the watch phase has strictly positive ROI:** once LDS (this phase) — and later RDS/EDS — are file-based, ONE watching phase lights up hot reload for every file-based resource type at once, instead of watching machinery being built for CDS alone and retrofitted per resource type.
  - **(b) File-based RDS** (`rds` on the HCM + `RouteConfiguration` from a file). Strong runner-up. Rejected for this phase: RDS is configured per-HCM (the `rds:` field replacing the inline `route_config:` — a mutually-exclusive-fields schema surgery on `HttpConnectionManagerConfig`, which today has `route_config` as a REQUIRED field at `bootstrap.rs:490-513`), its stat namespace is per-HCM-scoped (`http.<stat_prefix>.rds.<route_config_name>.*` — a different registration topology from the manager-level families), and no Envoy-side RDS surface pre-exists in any fixture allow-list (fixture 0011 configures no RDS, so Envoy emits no rds stats there — the §0-finding-3 head start does not apply). RDS is the natural NEXT continuation (it exercises the scoped/named config-source topology that EDS and SDS also use).
  - **(c) File-based EDS** (`eds_cluster_config` + `ClusterLoadAssignment` from a file). Rejected for this phase: requires a new `ClusterType::Eds` variant plus making `Cluster.load_assignment` conditional (today a REQUIRED field — `bootstrap.rs:133`; EDS clusters get endpoints from the file instead), a deeper validation-chain surgery than LDS's purely-additive schema. The `LoadAssignment` schema itself already matches the EDS payload shape (the survey confirmed). Remains seeded.
  - **(d) gRPC family.** Rejected — **still blocked**: the survey re-verified at HEAD that H1 chunked-decoding discards trailers (`crates/envoy-http1/src/client.rs:241-248`) and `envoy-http2` exposes no trailer API. Unchanged from the ADR-0048 option-(a) analysis.
  - **(e) Load-balancing / Observability / HTTP-3+QUIC / WASM-host / Network-filters / Runtime + hot restart / more HTTP filters.** Rejected — the ADR-0048 option-(b)–(e) analysis carries unchanged (nothing material changed at HEAD for any of these families).
  - **(f) xDS family continuation: file-based LDS, initial-load-only.** **Chosen.**
- **Decision:** adopt option (f). Phase 19 is **`19-xds-file-based-lds`**: `dynamic_resources.lds_config.path_config_source` — listeners loaded from a local YAML file at startup (initial-load-only), serving data-plane traffic, observable via the `listener_manager.lds.*` stat subset + the `/config_dump` `ListenersConfigDump` entry, bilaterally verified by fixture `0027-xds-file-based-lds` realizing Envoy's documented canonical filesystem-dynamic-config topology (an LDS-supplied listener routing to both a static cluster and a phase-18 CDS-supplied cluster). **Four non-obvious findings make this the lowest-risk phase the family can offer** (recorded per D-3.4/D-3.5; full statement in SPEC §0):
  1. **Every phase-18 extension point is a single-variant/single-field reuse** — `ConfigSource`/`PathConfigSource` reused verbatim for `lds_config`; the `cds.rs` `@type`-tagged envelope pattern reused for `Listener` resources (the existing `Listener` schema at `bootstrap.rs:284-298` parses everything an LDS payload carries); `load_dynamic_resources` gains a parallel branch; the harness `{{CDS_PATH}}` machinery generalizes to `{{LDS_PATH}}`.
  2. **Initial-load-only LDS needs no listener-manager refactor** — envoy-bin spawns `listeners.first()` (`main.rs:216`); the fixture topology (zero static listeners + one LDS listener) merges at config-load time and `first()` picks the dynamic listener; zero-static-listeners bootstraps are already valid when admin is configured (`bootstrap.rs:1939`).
  3. **The Envoy-side differential surface pre-exists as 12 allow-listed unasserted `listener_manager.*` names** (fixture 0011 `expectations.yaml:213-224`) — the third application of the §0-finding-3 pattern (phases 17, 18, 19). envoy-rust already registers `listener_manager.total_listeners_active` unconditionally (08.2 D14).
  4. **The LDS+CDS composition exercises real new machinery** — the merge-ordering invariant (dynamic clusters merge BEFORE dynamic-listener route re-validation), extending phase 18's defer-then-revalidate design (ADR-0049 decision 4) to dynamic-listener routes.
  **Scope boundary (minimum-viable):** deliver the `lds_config` schema (reusing `ConfigSource`); the LDS-file parser; the config-load-time listener merge + ordering + `all_listeners()` consumer migration; the conditional `listener_manager.{lds.update_attempt,lds.update_success,lds.update_failure,lds.update_rejected,listener_added}` stats + the `total_listeners_active` bilateral tightening; the conditional `ListenersConfigDump` entry; the harness `{{LDS_PATH}}` generalization; fixture 0027; the in-process backstop (incl. missing/malformed-file + listener-name-collision + unresolved-route negative paths); the fuzz seed (corpus 29→30); the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT LDS rows. **DEFER** (each rejected loudly by `deny_unknown_fields` today): file watching/hot reload for BOTH CDS and LDS (the family's prime follow-up — its §6.2 verification must run on Linux CI per the ADR-0049 Provenance note); file-based RDS/EDS/SDS/RTDS; multi-listener spawning (the pre-existing `first()` limitation is recorded, not lifted); listener drain/in-place-update semantics; `listener_filters` processing (the ADR-0026 parse-and-ignore posture); the gRPC/ADS transport + the ADS state machine + the in-harness control plane + the ADR-0014 protos supersession; delta xDS; `initial_fetch_timeout`; REST xDS.
- **Rationale:** the established axes all point the same way. **Foundation reuse:** every deliverable is a second instantiation of a phase-18 pattern (the envelope parser, the side-field merge, the conditional registration/emission, the harness dynamic-file machinery) — projected ~900–1300 LoC vs phase 18's ~1480–1600 actual. **Differential testability:** deterministic initial-load (readiness implies loaded), zero timing sensitivity, and the pre-existing allow-listed Envoy-side surface gives the fixture a head start. **Architectural risk:** lowest of any candidate — no refactor, no new crate, no new dep, no new driver, no new helper. **Charter coverage:** LDS is a named §9 family member, and the LDS+CDS pair is Envoy's own documented canonical filesystem-dynamic-config example — landing it is a meaningful narrative milestone ("envoy-rust runs Envoy's documented dynamic-filesystem quickstart topology"). **ADR-0028 remains unengaged** (no candidate this round engages it; the H1-listener × H2-cluster dispatch deferral stays with a future foundations-pivot phase). Recording the pick + findings here (vs only in the SPEC) honors D-3.4/D-3.5 — a future cold-start session must understand WHY the watch phase was deferred again (the three stacked risks + the ROI argument) and WHY LDS beat RDS/EDS (schema-surgery surface + the pre-existing allow-listed names).
- **Consequences:**
  - **Phase-19 SPEC is written to the option-(f) scope.** `docs/envoy-rust/phases/19-xds-file-based-lds/SPEC.md` lands alongside this ADR at the state-1 brainstorm commit, with §0 (the four findings), §1 (goal + fixture 0027 + acceptance signals), §2 (the stat subset + the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT extensions), §3 (D1–D8), §4 (the deferral ledger), §5 (invariants incl. the §5.7 merge-ordering invariant), §6.1 (split projection: NO split, ~900–1300 LoC / ~10–12 tasks), §6.2 (the 11-item empirical-verification checklist), and §7 (conditional ADRs). The ROADMAP gains row `19` (`status: planned`) beneath the "xDS / dynamic config family" heading at this commit (the SECOND concrete row there).
  - **No code changes at this commit** — the brainstorm is docs-only (SPEC + ROADMAP row + this ADR + STATE advance). Implementation is the state-3 work of a LATER session (subagent-driven per `feedback_execution_style`).
  - **Conditional follow-on ADRs reserved** (phase-19 SPEC §7): **ADR-0051** (PLAUSIBLE — §6.2 empirical-verification reconciliation; fires if the LDS file envelope shape, the missing/malformed-file disposition, or the `ListenersConfigDump` shape / `configs[]` ordering diverges from the projections; the `configs[]`-ordering item is also a fixture-0026 compatibility trigger; mirrors ADR-0037/0041/0043/0045/0047/0049) lands at the state-2 PLAN-write if it fires; **ADR-0052** (POSSIBLE — phase split; fires if the state-2 LoC estimate exceeds ~1500; seam `19.1` schema+parse+merge+backstop / `19.2` stats+config_dump+harness+fixture+close) reserved.
  - **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE** — the YAML-native shim is extended a second time (the LDS envelope), NOT superseded; the protos supersession remains a named deliverable of the future gRPC-xDS phase.
  - **ADR-0028** (H1-listener × H2-cluster dispatch deferral) **REMAINS OPEN** — phase 19 does not engage it.
  - **ADR-0049's decisions extend to LDS where applicable** (the always-YAML parsing posture; the all-fatal negative-path posture [§6.2 item 4 verifies whether Envoy's LDS split mirrors its CDS split]; the static-wins collision projection [§6.2 item 7]; the defer-then-revalidate reference enforcement [extended to dynamic-listener routes per SPEC §5.7]). Any divergence found at §6.2 lands in ADR-0051, not as an ADR-0049 edit (ADRs are append-only).
  - **`DECISIONS.md` ledger head:** **ADR-0050** (this ADR). Next available **ADR-0051**. Project-cumulative ADR count 51. The state-1 brainstorm commit title carries `[ADR-0050]`.
  - **STATE.md advances at this commit** to: Active phase `19` state-1-complete / state-2-next (next-skill `superpowers:writing-plans` scoped to the phase-19 SPEC); the prior "AWAITING NEXT PLANNING" status demoted to a `_Historical_` line; this ADR + the four findings documented in the new `### Phase-19 state-1 brainstorm` Notes subsection.
- **Provenance:** the four findings were surfaced at the phase-19 state-1 brainstorm via a read-only `Explore` subagent survey of the candidate code surfaces at HEAD `2044a6bf5` (the `DynamicResources`/`ConfigSource` structs at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:63-79`; the `cds.rs` envelope at `crates/envoy-config/src/cds.rs:31-46`; `load_dynamic_resources` at `crates/envoy-config/src/lib.rs:538` + its envoy-bin call site at `main.rs:54`; the `Listener` schema at `bootstrap.rs:284-298`; the single-listener spawn at `main.rs:216`; the listener stats at `crates/envoy-listener/src/lib.rs:145-195`; the `ConfigDumpEntry` enum at `crates/envoy-admin/src/endpoint.rs:303-323`; the harness dynamic-file machinery at `tests/differential/src/lib.rs:2184-2242`; the conditional-registration template at `crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:1060-1097`; the H1/H2 trailer absence at `crates/envoy-http1/src/client.rs:241-248`) + controller re-verification of the load-bearing claims by direct grep/read (the corrections noted in Context). The Envoy-side projections (the LDS file envelope, the `listener_manager.lds.*` stat tree, the `ListenersConfigDump` shape, the zero-static-listeners validity, the LDS+CDS composition semantics) are PROJECTIONS from Envoy's documented behavior + the phase-18 CDS empirical findings — they are empirically verified at the phase-19 state-2 PLAN-write §6.2 checklist BEFORE the PLAN locks them (the verify-at-PLAN-write discipline ratified across phases 10–18). The DECISIONS.md ledger head before this commit is **ADR-0049** (the phase-18 §6.2 reconciliation); ADR-0050 lands at the next-sequential number with no renumbering (ADR-0050 was reserved for a phase-18 split that did not fire, and is now consumed by this phase-19 scoping ADR — the ADR-0044/0046/0048 reserved-number-reuse precedent). Per D-3.5 this ADR lands inline at the state-1 brainstorm commit alongside the SPEC it scopes.

## ADR-0051: Phase-20 xDS-family continuation — file-based RDS (HCM `rds.config_source.path_config_source`), initial-load-only; chosen over CDS/LDS file watching (three stacked risks, ROI improved by deferral), file-based EDS (deeper schema surgery), and the still-blocked gRPC family; completes Envoy's core data-plane dynamic-resource triad (CDS+LDS+RDS) over the filesystem transport and introduces the named/scoped config-source idiom; defer file watching, scoped_routes/SRDS/VHDS, EDS/SDS/RTDS, the LDS+RDS composition showcase, and the gRPC/ADS transport

- **Date:** 2026-06-04.
- **Status:** accepted.
- **Context:** Phase 20 is the first phase after the xDS / dynamic config family's second member landed (phase 19, `19-xds-file-based-lds`, closed at `9fc072928`). Per the phase-19 close-out (STATE.md `## Next expected skill` at that HEAD), this brainstorm weighs the candidates on the established axes (foundation reuse; differential testability under the timing-robustness doctrine; architectural risk; §9 charter coverage; whether the OPEN ADR-0028 deferral is engaged) — **no phase was pre-picked**; the xDS family's nominal prime follow-up (CDS/LDS file watching/hot reload) was again to be weighed against the other §9 families on the merits. Method: cold-start artifact reads + ONE read-only `Explore` subagent survey of the candidate code surfaces at HEAD `9fc072928` (serial dispatch per `feedback_serial_subagent_dispatch`) + controller cross-checks of the load-bearing claims by direct grep/read (the `HttpConnectionManagerConfig.route_config` REQUIRED-field shape at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:524-549`; the git-tracked curated fuzz-corpus count [30, correcting the survey's report of 21,341 — that figure is the accumulated fuzzer output, git-ignored; the curated seeds are enumerated in `crates/envoy-config/fuzz/.gitignore`]; the config_dump entry ordering Bootstrap[0]/Clusters[1]/Listeners[2] at `crates/envoy-admin/src/endpoint.rs:467-519`).
- **Options considered:**
  - **(a) CDS/LDS file watching / hot reload + the mutability refactor** (the ledger's nominal prime follow-up, heading the ADR-0048/0050 §4 deferral list). **Rejected again for phase 20 — the same three stacked ADR-0050 risks, unchanged at HEAD:** (1) the `ClusterManager`/listener-manager mutability refactor is a guaranteed multi-sub-phase split (the survey re-confirmed `ClusterManager` immutable post-construction at `crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:599-625` with no public mutator; runtime add/update/remove additionally needs cluster warming, pool draining, and health/outlier-task lifecycle management); (2) a file-watch differential fixture is inherently timing-sensitive (write → watch fires → convergence window → assert), cutting against the timing-robustness doctrine every phase since 15 has been anchored on; (3) **the §6.2 verify-at-PLAN-write discipline cannot run for this phase in the local environment** — ADR-0049's Provenance records Envoy's inotify watching is unobservable under macOS Docker Desktop (virtiofs); the watch phase's §6.2 must be redesigned to run on Linux CI first. **Deferring the watch phase has even better ROI now:** with CDS + LDS + (this phase) RDS all file-based, ONE watching phase lights up hot reload for all THREE resource types at once, instead of watch machinery being built for one type and retrofitted.
  - **(b) File-based EDS** (`eds_cluster_config` + `ClusterLoadAssignment` from a file). Strong runner-up. Rejected for this phase: EDS requires a new `ClusterType::Eds` variant PLUS making `Cluster.load_assignment` conditional (today a REQUIRED non-`Option` field — `bootstrap.rs:169`, survey-confirmed; EDS clusters get endpoints from the file instead) — a deeper validation-chain surgery than RDS's HCM `route_config`→`Option` migration, and one with no named/scoped-resource idiom payoff. RDS's named/scoped config-source pattern (`route_config_name` selecting a resource by name) is the architecturally-correct precursor to EDS's `service_name` and SDS's secret-name selection. Remains seeded.
  - **(c) gRPC family.** Rejected — **still blocked**: the survey re-verified at HEAD that H1 chunked-decoding discards trailers (`crates/envoy-http1/src/client.rs:239-248`: "trailers discarded") and `envoy-http2` exposes no trailer API. Unchanged from the ADR-0048/0050 option analysis; a trailer-plumbing prerequisite phase would come first.
  - **(d) Load-balancing / Observability / HTTP-3+QUIC / WASM-host / Network-filters / Runtime + hot restart / more HTTP filters.** Rejected — the ADR-0048 option-(b)–(e) analysis carries unchanged (nothing material changed at HEAD for any of these families).
  - **(e) xDS family continuation: file-based RDS, initial-load-only.** **Chosen.**
- **Decision:** adopt option (e). Phase 20 is **`20-xds-file-based-rds`**: a `HttpConnectionManagerConfig.rds.config_source.path_config_source` — route configurations loaded from a local YAML file at startup (initial-load-only), routing data-plane traffic, observable via the per-HCM `http.<stat_prefix>.rds.<route_config_name>.*` stat subset + the `/config_dump` `RoutesConfigDump` entry, bilaterally verified by fixture `0028-xds-file-based-rds` (a static listener whose HCM's route table is RDS-supplied, with one route to a static cluster and one to a phase-18 CDS-supplied cluster — exercising the merge-ordering invariant). **Four findings make this a single, bounded phase** (recorded per D-3.4/D-3.5; full statement in SPEC §0):
  1. **The config-source machinery + the envelope parser are reused; the new schema shape is the HCM `route_config` XOR `rds` mutual exclusivity — the FIRST HCM-scoped dynamic resource.** `ConfigSource`/`PathConfigSource` (`bootstrap.rs:94-123`) reused verbatim; the `@type`-tagged envelope parser (`cds.rs`/`lds.rs`) generalizes to `RouteConfiguration` resources (`type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.route.v3.RouteConfiguration`; the existing `RouteConfiguration` schema at `bootstrap.rs:1017-1030` parses everything an RDS payload carries). The novelty: RDS is configured ON THE HCM (`rds:` replacing the REQUIRED inline `route_config:` at `bootstrap.rs:547`), making `route_config` an `Option` with a new sibling `rds: Option<Rds>`, validated exactly-one-of.
  2. **The merge-into-effective-`route_config` design needs no HCM runtime refactor.** `load_dynamic_resources` walks every HCM, loads the RDS file for each `rds`-configured HCM, selects the `RouteConfiguration` matching `route_config_name`, and populates the effective `route_config` — so downstream HCM dispatch (`crates/envoy-http1/src/hcm.rs:200`/`1177`, the H2 mirror) reads a populated `route_config` exactly as today (the only change is an Option-unwrap under the post-load invariant). The phase-18/19 "merge at config-load time, downstream sees a uniform shape" design.
  3. **RDS stats are PER-HCM-SCOPED (`http.<stat_prefix>.rds.<route_config_name>.*`) — a new registration topology** distinct from the process-level `cluster_manager.cds.*` / `listener_manager.lds.*` families; registered per-HCM at the site that already consumes `stat_prefix` (`hcm.rs:71-97`). This is the genuinely-new surface and the reason phase 20 is modestly heavier than phase 19.
  4. **No pre-existing allow-listed Envoy-side RDS surface — the §0-finding-3 head start does NOT apply** (fixture 0011 configures no RDS, so the fixture drives its bilateral assertions from scratch — making the §6.2 stat-name verification load-bearing). In exchange, RDS completes the core data-plane dynamic-resource triad (CDS clusters + LDS listeners + RDS routes over the filesystem) AND introduces the named/scoped config-source idiom that EDS/SDS reuse.
  **Scope boundary (minimum-viable):** deliver the `rds`-on-HCM schema (reusing `ConfigSource`) + the `route_config`→`Option` migration + the exactly-one-of validator; the RDS-file parser; the config-load-time HCM-walk + named-selection + effective-`route_config` merge + the CDS-before-RDS-route-revalidation ordering; the conditional per-HCM `http.<stat_prefix>.rds.<route_config_name>.{update_attempt,update_success,update_failure,update_rejected,config_reload}` stat subset; the conditional `RoutesConfigDump` entry; the harness `{{RDS_PATH}}` generalization; fixture 0028; the in-process backstop (incl. missing/malformed-file + `route_config_name`-mismatch + unresolved-route + both/neither-route-source negative paths); the fuzz seed (curated corpus 30→31); the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT RDS rows. **DEFER** (each rejected loudly by `deny_unknown_fields` today): file watching/hot reload for CDS+LDS+RDS (the family's prime follow-up — its §6.2 verification must run on Linux CI per the ADR-0049 Provenance note); `scoped_routes`/SRDS + VHDS; the LDS+RDS composition showcase (phase 20 anchors on a static listener; the D3 HCM walk is written over `all_listeners()` so it is composition-ready); multiple `rds` HCMs / multiple RouteConfigs per file; file-based EDS/SDS/RTDS; the gRPC/ADS transport + the ADS state machine + the in-harness control plane + the ADR-0014 protos supersession; delta xDS; `initial_fetch_timeout`; REST xDS.
- **Rationale:** the established axes all point the same way. **Foundation reuse:** the config-source structs, the `@type`-tagged envelope parser, the `load_dynamic_resources` merge framework, the conditional-registration technique, and the harness dynamic-file machinery are all reused; the three new surfaces (the HCM `Option` surgery, the per-HCM stat topology, the effective-`route_config` threading) are bounded first builds. **Differential testability:** deterministic initial-load (readiness implies loaded), zero timing sensitivity. **Architectural risk:** low — no refactor of any running subsystem, no new crate, no new dep, no new driver, no new helper; the one non-obvious wiring is the load-time stat-handle threading (D4). **Charter coverage:** RDS is a named §9 family member, and CDS+LDS+RDS over the filesystem completes Envoy's core data-plane dynamic-resource triad — a meaningful narrative milestone — while the named/scoped `route_config_name` idiom unlocks the pattern EDS/SDS build on. **ADR-0028 remains unengaged** (no candidate this round engages the H1-listener × H2-cluster dispatch deferral). RDS was the explicitly-named "natural NEXT continuation" in ADR-0050 option (b). Recording the pick + findings here (vs only in the SPEC) honors D-3.4/D-3.5 — a future cold-start session must understand WHY the watch phase was deferred a third time (the three stacked risks + the improved-ROI argument) and WHY RDS beat EDS (the shallower schema surgery + the named/scoped-idiom payoff).
- **Consequences:**
  - **Phase-20 SPEC is written to the option-(e) scope.** `docs/envoy-rust/phases/20-xds-file-based-rds/SPEC.md` lands alongside this ADR at the state-1 brainstorm commit, with §0 (the four findings), §1 (goal + fixture 0028 + acceptance signals), §2 (the per-HCM stat subset + the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT extensions), §3 (D1–D8), §4 (the deferral ledger), §5 (invariants incl. the §5.7 merge-ordering invariant extended to RDS routes + the §5.8 exactly-one-of-route-source invariant), §6.1 (split projection: NO split, ~1100–1450 LoC / ~11–13 tasks, less margin than phase 19), §6.2 (the 11-item empirical-verification checklist), and §7 (conditional ADRs). The ROADMAP gains row `20` (`status: planned`) beneath the "xDS / dynamic config family" heading at this commit (the THIRD concrete row there).
  - **No code changes at this commit** — the brainstorm is docs-only (SPEC + ROADMAP row + this ADR + STATE advance). Implementation is the state-3 work of a LATER session (subagent-driven per `feedback_execution_style`).
  - **Conditional follow-on ADRs reserved** (phase-20 SPEC §7): **ADR-0052** (PLAUSIBLE — §6.2 empirical-verification reconciliation; fires if the RDS file envelope / `rds`-on-HCM shape, the missing/malformed-file or `route_config_name`-mismatch disposition, or the `RoutesConfigDump` shape / `configs[]` ordering diverges from the projections; the `configs[]`-ordering item is also a fixture-0026/0027 compatibility trigger; mirrors ADR-0037/0041/0043/0045/0047/0049) lands at the state-2 PLAN-write if it fires; **ADR-0053** (POSSIBLE — phase split; fires if the state-2 LoC estimate exceeds ~1500; seam `20.1` schema+`route_config`-Option-migration+parser+merge+backstop / `20.2` per-HCM-stats+RoutesConfigDump+harness+fixture+close) reserved.
  - **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE** — the YAML-native shim is extended a third time (the RDS envelope), NOT superseded; the protos supersession remains a named deliverable of the future gRPC-xDS phase.
  - **ADR-0028** (H1-listener × H2-cluster dispatch deferral) **REMAINS OPEN** — phase 20 does not engage it.
  - **ADR-0049's decisions extend to RDS where applicable** (the always-YAML parsing posture; the all-fatal negative-path posture [§6.2 item 4/6 verify whether Envoy's RDS split mirrors its CDS/LDS split]; the defer-then-revalidate reference enforcement [extended to RDS-supplied routes per SPEC §5.7]). The ADR-0050 L6 finding (LDS routes need no `validate_clusters: false`) is RE-OPENED for the RDS-supplied context (§6.2 item 7). Any divergence found at §6.2 lands in ADR-0052, not as an ADR-0049/0050 edit (ADRs are append-only).
  - **`DECISIONS.md` ledger head:** **ADR-0051** (this ADR). Next available **ADR-0052**. Project-cumulative ADR count 52. The state-1 brainstorm commit title carries `[ADR-0051]`.
  - **STATE.md advances at this commit** to: Active phase `20` state-1-complete / state-2-next (next-skill `superpowers:writing-plans` scoped to the phase-20 SPEC); the prior "AWAITING NEXT PLANNING" status demoted to a `_Historical_` line; this ADR + the four findings documented in the new `### Phase-20 state-1 brainstorm` Notes subsection.
- **Provenance:** the four findings were surfaced at the phase-20 state-1 brainstorm via a read-only `Explore` subagent survey of the candidate code surfaces at HEAD `9fc072928` (the `HttpConnectionManagerConfig` struct + the REQUIRED `route_config` field at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:524-549`; the `RouteConfiguration` schema at `bootstrap.rs:1017-1030`; the `DynamicResources`/`ConfigSource`/`PathConfigSource` structs at `bootstrap.rs:94-123`; the `cds.rs` parser at `crates/envoy-config/src/cds.rs:42-57` + the `lds.rs` parser at `crates/envoy-config/src/lds.rs:36-53`; `load_dynamic_resources` at `crates/envoy-config/src/lib.rs:571-656` + its envoy-bin call site at `main.rs:51-54`; the per-HCM stat registration at `crates/envoy-http1/src/hcm.rs:71-97` + the `route_config` consumers at `hcm.rs:200`/`1177`; the `register_lds_stats` conditional template at `crates/envoy-listener/src/lib.rs:369-393` + the CDS template at `crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:1060-1097`; the `ConfigDumpEntry` enum at `crates/envoy-admin/src/endpoint.rs:301-338` + the render ordering at `:467-519`; the harness `{{CDS_PATH}}`/`{{LDS_PATH}}` machinery at `tests/differential/src/lib.rs:2187-2249`; the REQUIRED `Cluster.load_assignment` at `bootstrap.rs:169` + the two-variant `ClusterType`; the immutable `ClusterManager` at `crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:599-625`; the H1/H2 trailer absence at `crates/envoy-http1/src/client.rs:239-248`) + controller re-verification of the load-bearing claims by direct grep/read (the corrections noted in Context — notably the curated fuzz-corpus count of 30, not the survey's accumulated-output figure of 21,341). The Envoy-side projections (the RDS file envelope, the `rds`-on-HCM config shape, the per-HCM `http.<prefix>.rds.<name>.*` stat tree, the `RoutesConfigDump` shape + `configs[]` index, the `route_config_name`-mismatch disposition, the RDS+CDS composition semantics) are PROJECTIONS from Envoy's documented behavior + the phase-18/19 CDS/LDS empirical findings — they are empirically verified at the phase-20 state-2 PLAN-write §6.2 checklist BEFORE the PLAN locks them (the verify-at-PLAN-write discipline ratified across phases 10–19). The DECISIONS.md ledger head before this commit is **ADR-0050** (the phase-19 scoping ADR); ADR-0051 lands at the next-sequential number with no renumbering (ADR-0051 was reserved for the phase-19 §6.2 reconciliation that did NOT fire, and is now consumed by this phase-20 scoping ADR — the ADR-0044/0046/0048/0050 reserved-number-reuse precedent). ## ADR-0052: Phase-20 §6.2 empirical-verification reconciliation — the `/config_dump` `configs[]` ordering DIVERGES from the projection (Envoy interposes a `ScopedRoutesConfigDump` before `RoutesConfigDump` → Routes at `configs[4]`, not the projected `[3]`, with `SecretsConfigDump` at `[5]`; Envoy ALSO emits a `RoutesConfigDump` with `static_route_configs` even when no HCM uses RDS); reconciled by a per-side `JsonSubtreeRule` path override in the harness. The RDS envelope / `rds`-on-HCM shape (item 1) and the negative-path / name-mismatch disposition (item 4/6) both MATCH; `config_reload` ticks at initial load (stays in the subset); the RDS file is shareable (no per-side template); an RDS→CDS route needs NO `validate_clusters: false`

- **Date:** 2026-06-04.
- **Status:** accepted.
- **Context:** Phase 20's state-2 PLAN-write performed the SPEC §6.2 HEAVY empirical verification (the verify-at-PLAN-write discipline ratified across phases 10–19) against `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (digest `sha256:56da5afd7df364350ff92de4fb49a9b09957c17295f2899f0a31cd12c28770c2`) under Docker on darwin — a single foreground general-purpose subagent ran an `rds`-configured HCM (static listener) + a `cds_config` composition + a host backend + admin `/stats` and `/config_dump` scrapes, and exercised the 11-item checklist (SPEC §6.2) including the missing/malformed/semantic-invalid/name-mismatch/both/neither negative variants. SPEC §7 reserved ADR-0052 to fire if item 1 (the RDS envelope / `rds`-on-HCM shape), item 4/6 (the missing/malformed-RDS-file or `route_config_name`-mismatch disposition), or item 5 (the `RoutesConfigDump` shape / `configs[]` ordering — a fixture-0026/0027 compatibility trigger) diverged materially from the projections. **Item 5 DIVERGED; items 1 and 4/6 MATCHED.** This ADR records all 11 findings as PLAN lock-ins (L1–L11) and the single reconciliation decision the divergence forces.
- **The 11 findings (L1–L11; lock-ins for the PLAN):**
  1. **L1 — RDS envelope + `rds`-on-HCM shape: MATCH.** Both the bare `resources:` list AND the full `DiscoveryResponse` (`version_info:` + `resources:`) are accepted; each resource carries `@type: type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.route.v3.RouteConfiguration`. The HCM block is `rds: { route_config_name: <name>, config_source: { path_config_source: { path: <p> } } }`; `resource_api_version` is OPTIONAL (works present or absent). Mirrors the CDS/LDS envelope exactly (parser selection is file-extension-driven on Envoy → mount at a `.yaml` path; envoy-rust is always-YAML). The minimal working RDS file is a RouteConfiguration with `name` + `virtual_hosts[]` (each vh needs `name` + `domains` + `routes[]`, each route a `match` + an action).
  2. **L2 — initial-load / readiness ordering: MATCH.** The RDS route table is active before `/ready` first returns 200 and before workers start (the init manager blocks on RDS); the first request routes immediately, no warm-up window. envoy-rust mirrors via synchronous `load_dynamic_resources` (a `std::fs::read_to_string` between `parse_bootstrap` and HCM construction). No settle/timing machinery on either side.
  3. **L3 — per-HCM RDS stat names + values: MATCH, with `config_reload` IN the subset.** Prefix is `http.<stat_prefix>.rds.<route_config_name>.` (fixture 0028: `http.ingress_http.rds.local_route.`). After a successful initial load: `update_attempt: 1`, `update_success: 1`, `update_failure: 0`, `update_rejected: 0`, **`config_reload: 1`** (it DOES tick at initial load — it stays in the §2.1 5-name subset). Envoy-only names NOT asserted (enumerated): `version` (xxhash), `version_text` (the `version_info` string, empty for bare `resources:`), `update_time`, `config_reload_time_ms`, `update_empty`, `init_fetch_timeout`, `update_duration` (histogram). An inline-`route_config` HCM emits ZERO `http.<prefix>.rds.*` names (L10 inertness witness, confirmed).
  4. **L4 — missing/malformed/semantic-invalid disposition: MATCH (the same CDS/LDS 3-way split).** (a) nonexistent `path` → Envoy hard-exits at startup (`paths must refer to an existing path in the system`); (b) malformed YAML → Envoy starts-and-serves, `rds.update_failure: 1`, runtime 404; (c) semantically-invalid RouteConfiguration (e.g. a route with no action) → starts-and-serves, `rds.update_rejected: 1`, runtime 404. envoy-rust treats ALL of these as FATAL at startup (the ADR-0049 decision-2 all-fatal posture extended to RDS) — so `update_failure`/`update_rejected` register at 0 and are structurally unreachable non-zero; the negative paths are backstop-only.
  6. **L6 — `route_config_name` mismatch: MATCH (maps to `update_rejected`).** An RDS file lacking the HCM's `route_config_name` → Envoy starts-and-serves, `rds.update_rejected: 1` (`Unexpected RDS configuration (expecting local_route): <other>`), runtime 404. envoy-rust is FATAL (`RdsRouteConfigNotFound`) — the all-fatal extension; backstop-only.
  7. **L7 — RDS+CDS composition + `validate_clusters`: an RDS→CDS route needs NO `validate_clusters: false` (RDS behaves like LDS, NOT like CDS-context static routes).** The RDS-supplied route to the CDS-supplied `dynamic_backend` worked at initial load with the RouteConfiguration carrying no `validate_clusters` knob. (Contrast: a STATIC inline route to a CDS cluster DOES need `validate_clusters: false` per ADR-0049 L12; an LDS-supplied route does NOT per ADR-0050 L6 — RDS joins LDS.) envoy-rust's posture is UNCHANGED: RDS-supplied routes go through the same defer-then-revalidate enforcement (cluster-reference checks defer while the route source is configured-but-unloaded, then re-enforce post-merge against the effective static+dynamic cluster list); a route to a cluster in NEITHER list still fails envoy-rust startup (`UnknownCluster`) vs Envoy's runtime-503 — the ADR-0049 decision-4 narrow divergence extended to RDS-supplied routes (SPEC §5.7). The fixture's shared `rds.yaml` carries no `validate_clusters`.
  8. **L8 — route-through-RDS wire shape + RouteConfiguration field tolerance: MATCH + the RDS file is SHAREABLE across both proxies.** A GET through an RDS-supplied route is shape-identical to an inline-route response (200 + echo body + `x-envoy-upstream-service-time` + `server: envoy` + the standard allow-list; no RDS-specific header). The dynamic config_dump round-trips the input RouteConfiguration with NO injected Envoy-only fields, and a minimal RouteConfiguration requires only `name` + vh `name`/`domains` + a route `match` + an action — all fields envoy-rust's `deny_unknown_fields` parser accepts. **Therefore the differential fixture uses a SINGLE shared `rds.yaml` rendered per-side through the kv map (like the shared `cds.yaml`), NOT the per-side templates phase-19 LDS needed** (LDS needed per-side because its HCM payload carried Envoy-only fields; an RDS file is just a RouteConfiguration).
  9. **L9 — both/neither route source: MATCH (both fatal on Envoy AND envoy-rust).** An HCM with BOTH `route_config` AND `rds` → Envoy hard-exits (proto `oneof` already-set); an HCM with NEITHER → Envoy hard-exits (PGV `route_specifier is required`). envoy-rust matches the fatal disposition with a parse-time exactly-one-of validator: `AmbiguousRouteSource` (both) / `MissingRouteSource` (neither) — both `ConfigError` at parse, before any file is read (SPEC §5.8). No differential divergence (both sides fatal).
  10. **L10 — stat conditionality cross-check: MATCH.** An inline-`route_config` bootstrap emits ZERO `http.<prefix>.rds.*` names (the §5.2 inertness witness, confirmed empirically). envoy-rust gates the `rds.*` family on the owning HCM's `rds.is_some()`.
  11. **L11 — version_info / config_reload_time_ms (opportunistic): present on Envoy, Envoy-only.** The initial load carries `version`/`version_text`/`config_reload_time_ms`/`update_time` (and `version_text` mirrors the `DiscoveryResponse.version_info` string when supplied). No deliverable depends on these; not asserted.
  5. **L5 — `RoutesConfigDump` shape + `configs[]` ordering: DIVERGES (the ADR trigger).** The dynamic entry nests as `{ "@type": ".../RoutesConfigDump", "dynamic_route_configs": [ { "route_config": { "@type": ".../RouteConfiguration", "name": "local_route", "virtual_hosts": [...] }, "last_updated": "<ts>" } ] }` — NO `version_info` key in the dynamic entry (only `route_config` + `last_updated`). **The `configs[]` ordering is NOT the projected Bootstrap[0]/Clusters[1]/Listeners[2]/Routes[3]:** Envoy's actual order on the fixture-0028 topology is **Bootstrap[0], Clusters[1], Listeners[2], ScopedRoutes[3], Routes[4], Secrets[5]** — a `ScopedRoutesConfigDump` is interposed before `RoutesConfigDump`, shifting Routes to index **4**, and a `SecretsConfigDump` follows at 5. Clusters[1] and Listeners[2] are NOT displaced (fixtures 0026's `configs[1]` and 0027's `configs[2]` assertions still hold). Additionally, **Envoy emits a `RoutesConfigDump` entry even when no HCM uses RDS** (an inline route shows up under `static_route_configs[]`) — Envoy always emits the section; only the populated array differs.
- **Decision (the single reconciliation the L5 divergence forces):**
  1. **envoy-rust keeps the established conditional-emission discipline** (the phase-19 L10 `ListenersConfigDump` precedent): the `RoutesConfigDump` entry is emitted ONLY when some HCM has `rds.is_some()`. This is a deliberate, BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT-recorded narrowing vs Envoy (which always emits the section, with `static_route_configs` for inline routes) — it keeps fixtures 0014/0026/0027 byte-untouched (they emit no Routes entry). On fixture 0028 (cds configured, lds NOT, rds yes) envoy-rust pushes `RoutesConfigDump` AFTER the LDS-conditional block → at `configs[2]` (Bootstrap[0], Clusters[1], Routes[2]); Envoy has it at `configs[4]`.
  2. **The `configs[]` INDEX MISMATCH (envoy-rust [2] vs Envoy [4]) is reconciled by extending the differential harness `JsonSubtreeRule` with OPTIONAL per-side path overrides** (`path_envoy` / `path_envoy_rust`), mirroring the existing per-side text-line allow-list precedent (`allowlist_envoy_only_line_prefixes` et al.). When a side-specific path is present it overrides the shared `path` for that side; both sides still assert against the same `expected`. Fixture 0028 sets `path_envoy: configs.4.dynamic_route_configs.0.route_config.name`, `path_envoy_rust: configs.2.dynamic_route_configs.0.route_config.name`, `expected: local_route`. This is a backward-compatible, ~15-LoC harness addition (the shared-`path` behavior is unchanged when the per-side fields are absent — fixtures 0026/0027 and all prior json_shape rules are untouched).
  3. **No change to the SPEC scope or the deferral ledger.** The divergence is purely the config_dump assertion mechanism; the data-plane + stats + admin contract is otherwise as projected.
- **Rationale:** Per D-3.3 the contract is mechanical; the harness must assert what each proxy actually emits. A fixed shared index cannot match an entry that lands at different positions on the two proxies (Envoy carries always-present ScopedRoutes/Secrets sections envoy-rust does not implement at this scope; envoy-rust gates Routes conditionally). The two clean options were (a) a per-side subtree path or (b) backstop-only config_dump verification. Option (a) preserves the bilateral config_dump discipline fixtures 0026/0027 established (SPEC §1 probe 4 calls for a differential config_dump assertion), is a small backward-compatible harness addition, and reuses the per-side mechanism the harness already has for text lines — so (a) is chosen. Recording this here (vs only in the PLAN/BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT) honors D-3.5: a future session must understand WHY fixture 0028's config_dump assertion uses per-side paths (the ScopedRoutes interposition + the conditional-emission narrowing) without re-running the §6.2 verification.
- **Consequences:**
  - **The PLAN locks L1–L11 as above.** The §2.1 stat subset is the 5 names (incl. `config_reload`). The fixture uses a single shared `rds.yaml` (L8). The RDS file carries no `validate_clusters` (L7). The negative paths (missing/malformed/semantic-invalid/name-mismatch/both/neither) are backstop-only (L4/L6/L9, the all-fatal extension). The harness gains the per-side `JsonSubtreeRule` path override (D6); fixture 0028's config_dump assertion uses it (D7).
  - **BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT gains a "Filesystem transport (`path_config_source`) — phase 20 RDS extension" subsection** at Task 10 (the state-3 arc), recording L1–L11 in the phase-18/19 §(a)–(f) parallel structure, the per-HCM `rds.*` stat rows (§2.1), the conditional-emission narrowing vs Envoy's always-emitted `RoutesConfigDump`, and the `RoutesConfigDump` admin-body-shapes row.
  - **ADR-0053 (the phase split) does NOT fire.** The §6.2-refined estimate is ~1100–1450 LoC / 11 tasks (the per-side harness addition is ~15 LoC; the L8 shared-file simplification removes the per-side-RDS-template cost) — under the §6.1 ~1500-LoC / ~25-task gate. Phase 20 stays a single un-split phase. ADR-0053 remains reserved-but-unconsumed.
  - **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE** (the YAML-native shim — the RDS envelope is its third extension); **ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN** (phase 20 does not engage it). ADR-0049's decisions extend to RDS where applicable (always-YAML; all-fatal; defer-then-revalidate) per ADR-0051; the ADR-0050 L6 "no `validate_clusters` needed" finding is CONFIRMED for the RDS-supplied context (L7 above) — RDS joins LDS, not CDS-static.
  - **`DECISIONS.md` ledger head: ADR-0052** (this ADR). Next available **ADR-0053** (reserved for the split — does not fire this phase). Project-cumulative ADR count 53. The state-2 PLAN-write commit title carries `[ADR-0052]`.
- **Provenance:** the 11 findings were captured by a single foreground general-purpose subagent running `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (digest `sha256:56da5afd7df364350ff92de4fb49a9b09957c17295f2899f0a31cd12c28770c2`) under Docker on darwin at the phase-20 state-2 PLAN-write (2026-06-04), with the topology + the 11-item checklist of SPEC §6.2 (a static-listener `rds`-configured HCM + a `cds_config` composition + a host HTTP backend + `/stats`, `/stats?format=json`, `/config_dump` scrapes + the missing/malformed/semantic-invalid/name-mismatch/both/neither negative variants, each with captured exit codes + `docker logs` + stat lines + curl output). The controller cross-checked the load-bearing items against the SPEC projections and the phase-18/19 BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT lock-ins. The PLAN-time SPEC-correction pass (a read-only `Explore` subagent + controller re-verification by direct grep/read at HEAD `a3ef29786`) confirmed all 13 SPEC §0/§3 code anchors with NO drift, enumerated the D1 `route_config`→`Option` migration sites (11 `HttpConnectionManagerConfig` struct-literal constructions — 3 in `envoy-http1` tests, 8 in `envoy-http2` tests — + the production read sites: the `bootstrap.rs` validator `:2370-2375`, `clone_route_config` at `envoy-http1/src/hcm.rs:200`/`:211`, the vhost match `:1177`; H2 reuses `HCMConfig` via a type alias so it has no separate production read site; + ~9 test read sites in `bootstrap.rs`), and established that the harness `JsonSubtreeRule` (`tests/differential/src/lib.rs:612-617`) currently has NO per-side path support (the gap this ADR's decision 2 fills). Per D-3.5 this ADR lands at the state-2 PLAN-write commit alongside the PLAN it informs.

## ADR-0053: Phase-21 xDS-family continuation — file-based EDS (`Cluster.eds_cluster_config.eds_config.path_config_source`), initial-load-only; chosen over CDS/LDS/RDS file watching (three stacked risks, ROI improved by deferral to its best yet) and the still-blocked gRPC family; extends Envoy's filesystem-dynamic-config surface to the ENDPOINT layer (the first CLUSTER-scoped dynamic resource) and reuses the named/scoped config-source idiom; defer file watching, multi-endpoint/locality EDS, endpoint health-status-in-EDS, the EDS+CDS composition, SDS/RTDS, scoped_routes/SRDS/VHDS, and the gRPC/ADS transport

- **Date:** 2026-06-04.
- **Status:** accepted.
- **Context:** Phase 21 is the first phase after the xDS / dynamic config family's third member landed (phase 20, `20-xds-file-based-rds`, closed at `2495f0451`). Per the phase-20 close-out (STATE.md `## Next expected skill` at that HEAD), this brainstorm weighs the candidates on the established axes (foundation reuse; differential testability under the timing-robustness doctrine; architectural risk; §9 charter coverage; whether the OPEN ADR-0028 deferral is engaged) — **no phase was pre-picked**; the xDS family's nominal prime follow-up (CDS/LDS/RDS file watching/hot reload) was again to be weighed against the other §9 families on the merits. Method: cold-start artifact reads + ONE read-only `Explore` subagent survey of the candidate code surfaces at HEAD `2495f0451` (serial dispatch per `feedback_serial_subagent_dispatch`) + controller cross-checks of the load-bearing claims by direct grep/read (the REQUIRED `Cluster.load_assignment` field at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:181` + the two-variant `ClusterType` at `:225-239`; the `LoadAssignment`/`LocalityLbEndpoints`/`LbEndpoint`/`Endpoint`/`Address` hierarchy at `:262-328`; the endpoint-build dispatch over `cfg.load_assignment.endpoints` at `crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:734-797`; the per-cluster stat registration at `:817-884`; the `cds.rs`/`lds.rs`/`rds.rs` `@type`-tagged envelope parsers; `load_dynamic_resources` at `crates/envoy-config/src/lib.rs:623-764`; the `ConfigDumpEntry` enum at `crates/envoy-admin/src/endpoint.rs:301-350`; the harness `{{CDS_PATH}}`/`{{LDS_PATH}}`/`{{RDS_PATH}}` machinery at `tests/differential/src/lib.rs`; the absence of any `eds`/`eds_config`/`EdsClusterConfig` surface today; the git-tracked curated fuzz-corpus count of 31). **NOTE (decision-relevant for the user-of-record):** at this brainstorm the operator considered the watching phase and an all-three-resource-types watching scope before directing file-based EDS — the recorded continuation pick.
- **Options considered:**
  - **(a) CDS/LDS/RDS file watching / hot reload + the mutability refactor** (the ledger's nominal prime follow-up, heading the ADR-0048/0050/0051 §4 deferral list). **Rejected again for phase 21 — the same three stacked ADR-0050 risks, unchanged at HEAD:** (1) the `ClusterManager`/listener-manager/HCM-route-table mutability refactor is a guaranteed multi-sub-phase split (the survey re-confirmed `ClusterManager` immutable post-construction with no public mutator; runtime add/update/remove additionally needs cluster warming, pool draining, and health/outlier-task lifecycle management); (2) a file-watch differential fixture is inherently timing-sensitive (write → watch fires → convergence window → assert), cutting against the timing-robustness doctrine every phase since 15 has been anchored on; (3) **the §6.2 verify-at-PLAN-write discipline cannot run for that phase in the local environment** — ADR-0049's Provenance records Envoy's inotify watching is unobservable under macOS Docker Desktop (virtiofs); the watch phase's §6.2 must be redesigned to run on Linux CI first. **Deferring the watch phase has the BEST ROI yet:** with CDS + LDS + RDS + (this phase) EDS all file-based, ONE watching phase lights up hot reload for all FOUR resource types at once, instead of watch machinery being built piecemeal. **(File-based EDS at INITIAL load has NONE of these risks — its §6.2 runs locally, its fixture is deterministic, and it needs no mutability refactor.)**
  - **(b) File-based EDS** (`eds_cluster_config` + `ClusterLoadAssignment` from a file). **Chosen** — the runner-up at the phase-19 and phase-20 brainstorms, picked now. It completes the filesystem-transport surface down to the ENDPOINT layer (the last static file-based core resource type before the watching capstone), reusing the proven envelope/merge/harness machinery; its schema surgery (`ClusterType::Eds` + making the REQUIRED `Cluster.load_assignment` optional, validated exactly-one-of-and-consistent-with-`cluster_type`) is comparable in weight to RDS's HCM `route_config`→`Option` migration; and it reuses the named/scoped config-source idiom RDS introduced (`route_config_name` → `service_name`). Its §6.2 runs LOCALLY (no virtiofs dependency — initial-load-only).
  - **(c) gRPC family.** Rejected — **still blocked**: the survey re-verified at HEAD that H1 chunked-decoding discards trailers (`crates/envoy-http1/src/client.rs`) and `envoy-http2` exposes no trailer API. Unchanged from the ADR-0048/0050/0051 option analysis; a trailer-plumbing prerequisite phase would come first.
  - **(d) SDS / RTDS / scoped_routes / Load-balancing / Observability / HTTP-3+QUIC / WASM-host / Network-filters / Runtime + hot restart / more HTTP filters.** Rejected for this phase — the ADR-0048 option analysis carries unchanged; EDS is the architecturally-coherent next file-based xDS resource (clusters→listeners→routes→**endpoints**), and SDS (the other cluster/socket-scoped config source) is its natural successor. All remain seeded.
  - **(e) An ambitious all-three-resource-types watching scope** (raised in-session) — Rejected as exactly the "guaranteed multi-sub-phase split" the ledger warns against; watching of any single type already triggers the mutability refactor + timing-sensitive fixture + Linux-CI-only §6.2; bundling three multiplies the risk with no green-build release valve short of an immediate split.
- **Decision:** adopt option (b). Phase 21 is **`21-xds-file-based-eds`**: a `Cluster.eds_cluster_config.eds_config.path_config_source` — a cluster's endpoints (a `ClusterLoadAssignment`) loaded from a local YAML file at startup (initial-load-only), routing data-plane traffic, observable via the per-cluster `cluster.<name>.{update_attempt,update_success,…}` EDS-subscription stat subset + the `/config_dump` `EndpointsConfigDump` entry, bilaterally verified by fixture `0029-xds-file-based-eds` (a static cluster whose endpoint list is EDS-supplied, single endpoint, anchored on a static listener). **Four findings make this a single, bounded phase** (recorded per D-3.4/D-3.5; full statement in SPEC §0):
  1. **The config-source machinery + the envelope parser are reused; the new schema shape is `ClusterType::EDS` + `eds_cluster_config` ON THE CLUSTER + making the REQUIRED `Cluster.load_assignment` field optional — the FIRST CLUSTER-scoped dynamic resource.** `ConfigSource`/`PathConfigSource` (`bootstrap.rs:107-123`) reused verbatim inside a new `EdsClusterConfig { eds_config, service_name }`; the `@type`-tagged envelope parser generalizes to `ClusterLoadAssignment` resources (`type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.endpoint.v3.ClusterLoadAssignment`; the existing `LoadAssignment` schema at `bootstrap.rs:262-328` parses everything an EDS payload carries). The novelty: EDS is configured ON THE CLUSTER (`type: EDS` + `eds_cluster_config:` replacing the REQUIRED inline `load_assignment:` at `bootstrap.rs:181`), making `load_assignment` an `Option`, with `ClusterType` gaining a third variant, validated exactly-one-of-and-consistent-with-`cluster_type`.
  2. **The merge-into-effective-`load_assignment` design needs no cluster runtime refactor.** `load_dynamic_resources` walks every (static + CDS) cluster, loads the EDS file for each `type: EDS` cluster, selects the `ClusterLoadAssignment` matching `service_name`-or-cluster-name, and populates the effective `load_assignment` — so the downstream endpoint-build (`crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:734-797`) reads a populated `load_assignment` exactly as today (the only change is an Option-unwrap under the post-load invariant). The phase-18/19/20 "merge at config-load time, downstream sees a uniform shape" design.
  3. **EDS stats are PER-CLUSTER-scoped (`cluster.<name>.update_*`) — extending the EXISTING per-cluster namespace** (the phase-12.1 `membership_*` site at `cluster.rs:817-884`), distinct from the process-level `cluster_manager.cds.*` / `listener_manager.lds.*` families and the per-HCM `http.<prefix>.rds.<name>.*` family; the `update_*` warming-subscription family on a cluster is new but registers at an existing site — making EDS's stat surface modestly LIGHTER than RDS's brand-new per-HCM keying.
  4. **Cluster warming is the EDS-specific disposition question, and there is no pre-existing allow-listed Envoy-side EDS surface** (the existing fixtures' clusters are STATIC, so the §6.2 stat-name verification is load-bearing). The genuinely-new semantic: an EDS cluster with no assignment "warms" in Envoy (held out of the active set until its first `ClusterLoadAssignment` arrives or `initial_fetch_timeout` fires); for file-based EDS at initial load the file is read synchronously, so warming resolves immediately — but the missing-file/missing-resource disposition (warm-and-503 vs fatal-exit) is the load-bearing §6.2 question (the EDS analogue of the RDS `route_config_name`-mismatch question; the projected all-fatal posture per ADR-0049 decision 2 is the most likely ADR-0054 reconciliation trigger). In exchange, EDS extends the filesystem-dynamic-config surface to the endpoint layer AND reuses the named/scoped config-source idiom.
  **Scope boundary (minimum-viable):** deliver the `ClusterType::Eds` + `eds_cluster_config`-on-cluster schema (reusing `ConfigSource`) + the `load_assignment`→`Option` migration + the exactly-one-of-and-consistent validator; the EDS-file parser; the config-load-time cluster-walk + named-selection + effective-`load_assignment` merge + the CDS-before-EDS-pass ordering; the conditional per-cluster `cluster.<name>.{update_attempt,update_success,update_failure,update_empty}` stat subset; the conditional `EndpointsConfigDump` entry; the harness `{{EDS_PATH}}` generalization (incl. the EDS rendition in the backend-detection scans — the EDS file carries the backend endpoint marker); fixture 0029 (single endpoint, static cluster); the in-process backstop (incl. missing/malformed-file + missing-`ClusterLoadAssignment` + EDS-cluster-with-`load_assignment` + non-EDS-cluster-with-`eds_cluster_config` + neither-source negative paths); the fuzz seed (curated corpus 31→32); the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT EDS rows. **DEFER** (each rejected loudly by `deny_unknown_fields` today): file watching/hot reload for CDS+LDS+RDS+EDS (the family's prime follow-up — its §6.2 must run on Linux CI per the ADR-0049 Provenance note); multi-endpoint/locality-weighted/priority EDS (needs the Load-balancing-family distinguishable-backend infrastructure); endpoint health-status-in-EDS (`LbEndpoint.health_status`); the EDS-cluster-supplied-by-CDS composition showcase (phase 21 anchors EDS on a static cluster; the D3 walk covers `all_clusters()` so it is composition-ready); multiple EDS clusters / multiple `ClusterLoadAssignment`s per file; SDS + RTDS; `scoped_routes`/SRDS + VHDS; the gRPC/ADS transport + the ADS state machine + the in-harness control plane + the ADR-0014 protos supersession; delta xDS; `initial_fetch_timeout`; REST xDS.
- **Rationale:** the established axes all point the same way. **Foundation reuse:** the config-source structs, the `@type`-tagged envelope parser, the `load_dynamic_resources` merge framework, the conditional-registration technique, the `LoadAssignment` payload schema, and the harness dynamic-file machinery are all reused; the new surfaces (the `ClusterType::Eds` + `eds_cluster_config` cluster-scoped schema surgery, the `load_assignment`→`Option` migration, the per-cluster `update_*` family, the effective-`load_assignment` threading) are bounded first builds. **Differential testability:** deterministic initial-load (readiness implies loaded), single endpoint, zero timing sensitivity — and (unlike the watching phase) a §6.2 that runs LOCALLY. **Architectural risk:** low — no refactor of any running subsystem, no new crate, no new dep, no new driver, no new helper; the one non-obvious wiring is the load-time stat-handle threading (D4, the phase-20 precedent). **Charter coverage:** EDS is a named §9 family member, and CDS+LDS+RDS+EDS over the filesystem extends Envoy's dynamic-config surface to the endpoint layer — the four core file-based resource types — while the named/scoped `service_name` idiom continues the pattern SDS builds on. **ADR-0028 remains unengaged** (no candidate this round engages the H1-listener × H2-cluster dispatch deferral). EDS was the explicitly-named runner-up in ADR-0051 option (b). Recording the pick + findings here (vs only in the SPEC) honors D-3.4/D-3.5 — a future cold-start session must understand WHY the watch phase was deferred a fourth time (the three stacked risks + the now-best ROI argument) and WHY EDS was the chosen continuation (it completes the file-based core resource quartet at low risk, with a locally-verifiable §6.2).
- **Consequences:**
  - **Phase-21 SPEC is written to the option-(b) scope.** `docs/envoy-rust/phases/21-xds-file-based-eds/SPEC.md` lands alongside this ADR at the state-1 brainstorm commit, with §0 (the four findings), §1 (goal + fixture 0029 + acceptance signals), §2 (the per-cluster stat subset + the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT extensions), §3 (D1–D8), §4 (the deferral ledger), §5 (invariants incl. the §5.7 merge-ordering invariant extended to the EDS endpoint pass + the §5.8 exactly-one-of-and-consistent endpoint-source invariant), §6.1 (split projection: NO split, ~1100–1450 LoC / ~11–13 tasks, comparable margin to phase 20), §6.2 (the 11-item empirical-verification checklist, runnable LOCALLY), and §7 (conditional ADRs). The ROADMAP gains row `21` (`status: planned`) beneath the "xDS / dynamic config family" heading at this commit (the FOURTH concrete row there).
  - **No code changes at this commit** — the brainstorm is docs-only (SPEC + ROADMAP row + this ADR + STATE advance). Implementation is the state-3 work of a LATER session (subagent-driven per `feedback_execution_style`).
  - **Conditional follow-on ADRs reserved** (phase-21 SPEC §7): **ADR-0054** (PLAUSIBLE — §6.2 empirical-verification reconciliation; fires if the EDS file envelope / `eds_cluster_config`-on-cluster shape, the cluster-warming + missing-file/missing-resource disposition [the most likely trigger — Envoy's warming posture may diverge from envoy-rust's projected all-fatal posture], or the `EndpointsConfigDump` shape / `configs[]` ordering [a fixture-0026/0027/0028 compatibility trigger] diverges from the projections; mirrors ADR-0037/0041/0043/0045/0047/0049/0052) lands at the state-2 PLAN-write if it fires; **ADR-0055** (POSSIBLE — phase split; fires if the state-2 LoC estimate exceeds ~1500; seam `21.1` schema+`load_assignment`-Option-migration+parser+merge+backstop / `21.2` per-cluster-stats+EndpointsConfigDump+harness+fixture+close) reserved.
  - **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE** — the YAML-native shim is extended a FOURTH time (the EDS `ClusterLoadAssignment` envelope), NOT superseded; the protos supersession remains a named deliverable of the future gRPC-xDS phase.
  - **ADR-0028** (H1-listener × H2-cluster dispatch deferral) **REMAINS OPEN** — phase 21 does not engage it.
  - **ADR-0049's decisions extend to EDS where applicable** (the always-YAML parsing posture; the all-fatal negative-path posture [§6.2 item 4 verifies whether Envoy's EDS warming posture diverges — if so, recorded in ADR-0054]; the defer-then-revalidate reference enforcement [the EDS pass populates endpoints before the single post-merge re-validation per SPEC §5.7]). Any divergence found at §6.2 lands in ADR-0054, not as an ADR-0049 edit (ADRs are append-only).
  - **`DECISIONS.md` ledger head:** **ADR-0053** (this ADR). Next available **ADR-0054**. Project-cumulative ADR count 54. The state-1 brainstorm commit title carries `[ADR-0053]`. (ADR-0053 was reserved for phase-20's split, which did NOT fire, and is now consumed by this phase-21 scoping ADR — the ADR-0044/0046/0048/0050/0051 reserved-number-reuse precedent.)
  - **STATE.md advances at this commit** to: Active phase `21` state-1-complete / state-2-next (next-skill `superpowers:writing-plans` scoped to the phase-21 SPEC); the prior "AWAITING NEXT PLANNING" status demoted to a `_Historical_` line; this ADR + the four findings documented in the new `### Phase-21 state-1 brainstorm` Notes subsection.
- **Provenance:** the four findings were surfaced at the phase-21 state-1 brainstorm via a read-only `Explore` subagent survey of the candidate code surfaces at HEAD `2495f0451` (the REQUIRED `Cluster.load_assignment` field + the two-variant `ClusterType` at `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:174-239`; the `LoadAssignment`/`LocalityLbEndpoints`/`LbEndpoint`/`Endpoint`/`Address`/`SocketAddress` hierarchy at `:262-359`; the `DynamicResources`/`ConfigSource`/`PathConfigSource`/`Rds` structs at `:90-135`; the endpoint-build dispatch at `crates/envoy-cluster/src/cluster.rs:721-1099` [the STATIC/STRICT_DNS branches at `:734-797`, the per-cluster stat registration at `:817-884`, the immutable `ClusterManager` at `:596-645`, the conditional `cluster_manager.cds.*` template at `:1060-1097`]; the `cds.rs`/`lds.rs`/`rds.rs` `@type`-tagged envelope parsers; `load_dynamic_resources` + its CDS/LDS/RDS branches at `crates/envoy-config/src/lib.rs:623-764`; the `ConfigDumpEntry` enum at `crates/envoy-admin/src/endpoint.rs:301-350`; the harness `{{CDS_PATH}}`/`{{LDS_PATH}}`/`{{RDS_PATH}}` machinery in `tests/differential/src/lib.rs`; the confirmed ABSENCE of any `eds`/`eds_config`/`EdsClusterConfig` surface) + controller re-verification of the load-bearing claims by direct grep/read (notably the REQUIRED-non-`Option` `load_assignment` field, the two-variant `ClusterType`, and the curated fuzz-corpus count of 31). The Envoy-side projections (the EDS file envelope, the `eds_cluster_config`-on-cluster config shape, the per-cluster `cluster.<name>.update_*` EDS stat tree, the cluster-warming + missing-resource disposition, the `EndpointsConfigDump` shape + `configs[]` index, the `service_name` selection semantics) are PROJECTIONS from Envoy's documented behavior + the phase-18/19/20 CDS/LDS/RDS empirical findings — they are empirically verified at the phase-21 state-2 PLAN-write §6.2 checklist BEFORE the PLAN locks them (the verify-at-PLAN-write discipline ratified across phases 10–20), and crucially that §6.2 runs LOCALLY (file-based EDS at initial load has no virtiofs/inotify dependency). The DECISIONS.md ledger head before this commit is **ADR-0052** (the phase-20 §6.2 reconciliation); ADR-0053 lands at the next-sequential number with no renumbering. Per D-3.5 this ADR lands inline at the state-1 brainstorm commit alongside the SPEC it scopes.
