## ADR-0090: Phase-37 §6.2 reconciliation — the `url_path` / `PathMatcher` ground truth (LOCALLY verified against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0`)

**Status:** Accepted (phase-37 state-2 PLAN-write; `superpowers:writing-plans`). The reserved §6.2 reconciliation ADR for phase `37-rbac-url-path-condition`. Records the empirically-locked facts that `PLAN.md` is authored against (the phase-22..36 verify-at-PLAN-write discipline — no `[§6.2-PENDING]` projections survive into the PLAN). Builds on ADR-0089 (the phase-37 pick + scope), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal), ADR-0034 (the 19-byte `RBAC: access denied` body), ADR-0021 (`regex` permitted foundation), ADR-0087/0088 (the phase-36 RBAC SafeRegex-at-lowering fix + the M36-1 unanchored-partial carry-forward this phase anchored-locks). Supersedes nothing.

**Verdict: the SPEC §3/§6.2 projection is CONFIRMED across the board — no material divergence.** Two refinements are recorded (the `#fragment` codec-400 and the config-validity being boot-fatal on BOTH proxies, not merely envoy-rust-stricter). Because nothing materially overturns the SPEC, the §6.1 split does NOT fire (**ADR-0091 stays UNFIRED**), and the projected new `ConfigError` variant is DROPPED (serde + the existing lowering compile cover every validity case — see §D).

**Reconnaissance harness.** Stood up `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (the ENVOY_TARGET pin, digest `sha256:56da5afd…`) in Docker with an H1 `direct_response` listener (`route → direct_response{status:200, body:"ALLOWED-BODY"}`) + an `[envoy.filters.http.rbac, envoy.filters.http.router]` chain, RBAC `action: ALLOW`, single policy `p0`. Probes were sent over a RAW socket (Python, no client-side normalization) so the exact request-target bytes reach Envoy. Admin `/config_dump` scraped for wire round-trip. Each config-validity case booted in an isolated container (full teardown between — an early run was contaminated by a leftover container still bound to the ports; the clean re-run is authoritative).

**§A — `url_path` / `PathMatcher` wire shape (SPEC §3.1) — CONFIRMED.**
- `url_path: { path: { exact: "/allowed" } }` is ACCEPTED inside an RBAC `permissions[]` entry AND a `principals[]` entry (Envoy's `Principal` does carry `url_path` — Principal acceptance CONFIRMED). The boot is clean on both.
- `/config_dump` round-trips the inline form VERBATIM: `{"url_path": {"path": {"exact": "/allowed"}}}` (no `@type` wrapper, no field renaming). `safe_regex` round-trips as `{"url_path": {"path": {"safe_regex": {"regex": "^/allowed/[0-9]+$"}}}}`.
- `PathMatcher`'s only in-scope rule is `path` (a required `rule` oneof — an empty `url_path: {}` is boot-fatal, see §D). All StringMatcher modes flow through `path` unchanged (it IS the 04.2 `StringMatcher` — `exact` and `safe_regex` were exercised live; `prefix`/`suffix`/`contains` are the identical type, no separate Envoy test needed).

**§B — the EXACT path Envoy matches `url_path` against (SPEC §3.2 — THE key risk) — query-strip ONLY, no other transformation. CONFIRMED = the MVP projection.** Sweep against `url_path: { path: { exact: "/allowed" } }`, `action: ALLOW`, recorded ALLOW(200+body)/DENY(403+`RBAC: access denied`):

| request-target (raw on wire) | verdict | why |
|---|---|---|
| `/allowed` | **200** | exact match |
| `/allowed?x=1` | **200** | query (`?x=1`) STRIPPED → matches `/allowed` |
| `/allowed?` | **200** | empty query STRIPPED → matches `/allowed` |
| `/allowed#frag` | **400 Bad Request** | fragment in the request-target is rejected at the H1 codec — NEVER reaches `url_path` (a codec-level reject, NOT an RBAC verdict; see refinement R1) |
| `/al%6Cowed` (`%6C`=`l`) | **403** | NO percent-decoding (`/al%6Cowed` ≠ `/allowed`) |
| `/allowed/../allowed` | **403** | NO dot-segment normalization (`normalize_path` is off by default) |
| `//allowed` | **403** | NO slash-merging (`merge_slashes` is off by default) |
| `/allowed/` | **403** | trailing slash is significant under `exact` |
| `/ALLOWED` | **403** | case-sensitive |
| `/denied` | **403** | control: no match |

Conclusion: Envoy matches `url_path` against the request-target with **everything from the first `?` removed, and NOTHING else** — no percent-decode, no dot-segment/slash normalization, no case-folding. This is EXACTLY the SPEC's "strip at the first `?`, no other normalization." The query-strip is the load-bearing distinction the fixture proves (envoy-rust's route matcher compares the raw request-target byte-for-byte at `crates/envoy-http1/src/hcm.rs:1510-1521`; nothing strips the query today — so `/allowed?x=1` matching `url_path: { exact: "/allowed" }` requires the new strip-at-first-`?` helper). The fixture is locked to the portable subset (already-normalized, query-strip-only probes).

**§C — `safe_regex` `url_path` verdicts (SPEC §3.3) — CONFIRMED.** With an ANCHORED portable pattern `^/allowed/[0-9]+$` (RE2 ∩ `regex`-crate, anchored per M36-1 so partial==full): `/allowed/42` → **200**, `/allowed/999` → **200**, `/allowed/42?q=1` → **200** (query STRIPPED, then full-match), `/allowed/xx` → **403** (no match), `/allowed` → **403** (the full anchored match does not match `/allowed`). Confirms RE2 FULL-match semantics against the query-stripped path. A malformed pattern is boot-fatal (see §D). The fixture/backstop LOCK an anchored pattern (M36-1 anchored-locked, NOT consumed).

**§D — config-validity dispositions (SPEC §3.4) — ALL boot-fatal on BOTH proxies (refinement R2 — Envoy rejects too, not merely envoy-rust-stricter).** Each isolated-container boot:
- `url_path: {}` (empty `PathMatcher`) → **boot-FATAL** on Envoy: `PermissionValidationError.UrlPath … field: "rule", reason: is required`. envoy-rust: serde — `PathMatcher` has a REQUIRED `path: StringMatcher` field → "missing field `path`" at parse → boot-fatal.
- `url_path: { path: {} }` (empty `StringMatcher`) → **boot-FATAL** on Envoy: `PathMatcherValidationError.Path … field: "match_pattern", reason: is required`. envoy-rust: the `StringMatcher` hand-rolled visitor errors `"StringMatcher: missing mode key"` on a zero-mode-key map (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:2495`) → boot-fatal.
- `url_path: { foo: "bar" }` (unknown sub-key) → **boot-FATAL** on Envoy: `no such field: 'foo' … has unknown fields`. envoy-rust: `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` on `PathMatcher` → boot-fatal.
- `url_path: { path: { safe_regex: { regex: "[" } } }` (malformed RE2) → **boot-FATAL** on Envoy: `missing ]: [`. envoy-rust: `StringMatcher::compile_safe_regex()` called from the RBAC `lower_*` arm (the phase-36 fallible-lowering path) → `FilterError::InvalidConfig` → boot-fatal (NOT a first-request panic — never reaches `matcher.rs:90`'s `.expect` with `compiled == None`).

**Decision (PLAN-write design, §6.2-locked):**
1. **`PathMatcher` config struct** (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs`, near `MetadataMatcher`): a thin DERIVED struct `#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)] #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] pub struct PathMatcher { pub path: StringMatcher }` — NO hand-rolled visitor (the required `path` field + `deny_unknown_fields` + the inner `StringMatcher` visitor's own "missing mode key" cover §D cases 1-3). Exported from `crates/envoy-config/src/lib.rs`.
2. **`Permission::UrlPath(PathMatcher)` + `Principal::UrlPath(PathMatcher)`** variants (`bootstrap.rs:1409`/`:1491`): each enum gains the variant + a `"url_path"` arm in the hand-rolled `Deserialize` visitor + a `"url_path"` entry in its `KEYS` array + the `#[serde(rename = "url_path")]` Serialize arm.
3. **Validator leaf arms** `Permission::UrlPath(_) => Ok(())` / `Principal::UrlPath(_) => Ok(())` in `validate_permission_tree`/`validate_principal_tree` (`bootstrap.rs:3953`/`:4002`) — mirroring the `Header(_) => Ok(())` leaf (no semantic check beyond serde; the SafeRegex compiles at lowering, not here, exactly like the `Header` arm). **NO new `ConfigError` variant** (the SPEC §3.4 projected one is DROPPED — every §D case maps to an existing error path: serde-parse error, or `FilterError::InvalidConfig` at lowering).
4. **Runtime** (`crates/envoy-filter/src/rbac.rs`): `RuntimePermission::UrlPath(StringMatcher)` / `RuntimePrincipal::UrlPath(StringMatcher)` — hold the inner `StringMatcher` DIRECTLY (the `PathMatcher` wrapper is trivial; the eval just calls `sm.matches(stripped)`). The `eval_permission`/`eval_principal` arm calls a free `strip_query(&req.path)` helper (`req.path.split('?').next().unwrap_or(&req.path)` — substring before the first `?`) then `sm.matches(stripped)`. The `lower_permission`/`lower_principal` arm does `let mut sm = pm.path.clone(); sm.compile_safe_regex().map_err(|e| FilterError::InvalidConfig{message: e.to_string()})?; RuntimePermission::UrlPath(sm)` — reusing `StringMatcher::compile_safe_regex()` (`bootstrap.rs:4520`), the phase-36 fallible-lowering mechanism UNCHANGED.
5. **Fixture `0045-http-rbac-url-path`**: H1 `direct_response` listener (body `"ok\n"` per the 0043 precedent) + a plain `[rbac, router]` chain (NO producer); `action: ALLOW` single policy with `url_path: { path: { exact: "/allowed" } }` as a **Permission**; the `http1_probe_list` driver (the 0043/0044 driver UNCHANGED — it already supports per-probe `path`) with 3 path-varying probes: `/allowed`→200+`ok\n`, `/denied`→403+`RBAC: access denied`, `/allowed?x=1`→200+`ok\n` (the query-strip discriminator). NO new comparator/driver/`extra_headers` capability.
6. **Backstop** (in-process unit tests in `rbac.rs`): the richer matrix — `exact`/`prefix`/`suffix`/`contains` match+miss; query-strip + no-query; `url_path` inside `and_rules`/`or_rules`/`not_rule`; as a `Principal`; DENY-action inversion; an ANCHORED `safe_regex` `url_path` match+reject (no panic); the §D boot-fatal cases (empty `PathMatcher` / `path:{}` / unknown sub-key at parse; malformed `safe_regex` at `build_from_config` lowering).
7. **Fuzz**: a `parse_bootstrap` seed `hcm_rbac_url_path.yaml` (a `url_path` RBAC condition incl. a `safe_regex` value) + its `!corpus/parse_bootstrap/hcm_rbac_url_path.yaml` un-ignore line in `crates/envoy-config/fuzz/.gitignore` (verify `git ls-files`). **NO new fuzz target** (reuses `parse_bootstrap` + the existing `regex` compile path; no `ci.yml` change).
8. **BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT**: a new RBAC `url_path` subsection (after the phase-35/36 metadata subsections) recording the query-strip semantic + the no-further-normalization carry-forward.

**Refinements recorded (neither blocks; both fixture-avoided):**
- **R1 — `#fragment` is a codec-level 400, not a `url_path` verdict.** `/allowed#frag` → Envoy 400 Bad Request at the H1 codec (the `#` is invalid in an origin-form request-target); it never reaches `url_path` matching. OUT of the fixture (it tests H1-codec request-target validation, not `url_path`; envoy-rust's H1 codec handling of a literal `#` in the request line is a SEPARATE surface). Named carry-forward **M37-1** (codec request-target `#`-handling differential — unverified; whenever the H1 request-line validation surface is next touched).
- **R2 — config-validity is boot-fatal on BOTH proxies.** The §D cases reject at Envoy boot too (not merely envoy-rust-stricter as §3.4 hedged). envoy-rust's all-fatal posture (ADR-0049) MATCHES Envoy here. The harness does not differentially test boot-FAILURE configs (no listener comes up), so §D is covered by envoy-rust backstop boot-fatal unit tests + this ADR's record of Envoy's matching rejection — NOT a per-fixture cross-proxy probe.

**Path-normalization-beyond-query-strip carry-forward.** §B confirms Envoy applies NO normalization beyond query-strip by default (percent-decode/dot-segment/slash-merge/case all OFF). The SPEC §2.2 deferral ("a faithful path-normalization slice is its own future increment") therefore needs NO fixture-avoidance dance for THIS pin's defaults — the query-strip-only fixture is already byte-portable. The deferral stands for a future config that turns `normalize_path`/`merge_slashes` ON (cross-cutting — route matching + access log share it); explicitly OUT of phase-37 scope.

**Consequences.** `PLAN.md` is authored against §A-§D inline (no projections). Estimate ~6–9 TDD tasks / ~350–550 LoC net — under the §6.1 ~25-task / ~1500-LoC gate → **NO split; ADR-0091 stays UNFIRED**. NO new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant/`ConfigError` variant. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds. New carry-forward **M37-1** (R1, codec `#`-handling). **M36-1** (unanchored SafeRegex partial-vs-full) is anchored-locked in the fixture/backstop, NOT consumed. **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0090** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 90; next-available **ADR-0091**, RESERVED for the §6.1 split which this ADR confirms does NOT fire — it stays available for a future split trigger). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** config-validity. The state-3 implementation is the next session (`superpowers:executing-plans` / `subagent-driven-development`, TDD per task).

## ADR-0091: Phase-38 pick + scope — **open the byte-exact Observability access-log-encoder vein** with the `json_format` output mode on `envoy.extensions.access_loggers.file.v3.FileAccessLog` (a `log_format.json_format` `Struct` map of keys → command-operator value strings, emitting ONE JSON object per request) + fixture `0046` — a byte-exact, DETERMINISTIC, LOCALLY-observable differential reusing the phase-32 command-operator engine + the existing `AccessLogRecord` + `FileSink` + the existing access-log differential harness with ZERO new connection-context plumbing, ZERO new request attribute, and NO new `HttpFilterInstance` variant / crate / dependency; choose `json_format` over the rejected alternatives below

**Status:** Accepted (phase-38 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `38-accesslog-json-format`. **Reclaims the ADR-0091 number** that ADR-0090 defensively reserved for the phase-37 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 37 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0091` is genuinely the next-free number; this ADR consumes it for the phase-38 pick. Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0078/0079 (the phase-32 command-operator engine + the `FileAccessLog.log_format.text_format_source` wire path + the verbatim-`FileSink` newline rule — and ADR-0078 §2.2 which EXPLICITLY DEFERRED `json_format`), ADR-0089 (the phase-37 pick, which named `json_format` "a fine FUTURE Observability pick"), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal).

**Context.** Phases 32–37 ran the Observability/HTTP-filters vein: phase 32 built the access-log command-operator engine (`crates/envoy-accesslog/src/command_operator.rs` — `parse_format`/`CompiledFormat`/`render` + the deterministic operator set + the absent-value `-` sentinel + the `:N` truncation) and added the `FileAccessLog.log_format.text_format_source.inline_string` TEXT format field, explicitly deferring `json_format` (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:682,695`; ADR-0078 §2.2). Phases 33/34 added the dynamic-metadata store + `%DYNAMIC_METADATA%` operator (producers); phases 35/36 added the RBAC `metadata` consumer + `present_match`/`safe_regex`; phase 37 widened the RBAC condition-TYPE axis with `url_path`. Both the RBAC-condition vein (the remaining types need connection-context plumbing) and the matcher-VALUE vein (the remaining non-string `ValueMatcher` variants need a shared non-string-Value generalization) have reached a natural pause that needs new infrastructure. ROADMAP rows `00`–`37` are all `done`; `37` was the highest defined row; the remaining family headings (`Runtime + hot restart`, `WASM host`, `Deprecated/edge`) are headings-only → this is a free new-phase pick. The phase-32 ADR-0078 named `json_format` the deferred sibling of the text format; the phase-37 ADR-0089 named it "a fine FUTURE Observability pick" — this phase realizes both.

**Options considered (the pick rationale + rejected alternatives):**
- **(CHOSEN) the `json_format` access-log encoder.** A new OUTPUT ENVELOPE over the EXISTING phase-32 engine + the EXISTING `AccessLogRecord` (16 fields incl. `dynamic_metadata`) + the EXISTING `FileSink` + the EXISTING `Driver::Http1WithAccessLog`/`AccessLogByteExactProbe` harness — it slots `json_format` in additively beside `text_format_source` on `SubstitutionFormatString`, compiles each map value through the SAME `parse_format`, and assembles a single-line JSON object. ZERO new connection-context plumbing, ZERO new request attribute, NO metadata store, NO producer chain, NO new `HttpFilterInstance` variant / crate / dependency. Byte-exact + deterministic + locally observable (an access-log scrape on a normal request/response, NOT Linux-CI-only); genuine differential richness via the JSON envelope (key ordering, value-string-quoting, JSON escaping, separators, the per-object terminator — the deterministic operators that fixture `0040` proved byte-exact as a TEXT line must now render byte-exact inside a JSON OBJECT). ~400–700 LoC / ~6–9 tasks — the cheapest-strong leaf.
- **(rejected) the connection-context RBAC conditions** — `destination_ip`/`destination_port` (Permission), `source_ip`/`direct_remote_ip`/`remote_ip` (Principal), `requested_server_name`/SNI (Permission). The same-filter continuation of phase 37, but EACH needs the downstream socket address (and, for SNI, the TLS handshake server-name) threaded into the filter — `FilterRequest` carries no socket address/SNI today (`crates/envoy-filter/src/types.rs`); a CIDR/IP matcher is its own new surface. Heavier per unit of differential strength (new plumbing) than `json_format`'s zero-plumbing reuse. Its own future RBAC-condition phase once a connection-context plumbing slice lands. (Would have folded carry-forward M37-2 — the `lower_principal` `url_path` coverage gap — since it touches `rbac.rs`; `json_format` does not, so M37-2 stays a live carry-forward.)
- **(rejected) the remaining non-string `ValueMatcher` variants** (`null`/`double`/`bool`/`list`/`or`) + `MetadataMatcher.invert` + multi-segment metadata `path` — the matcher-VALUE axis the non-string-Value generalization gates (the flat string-only store has no typed values; `present_match`, the cheapest, already shipped in phase 36). Lower differential-strength-per-LoC than `json_format`, and the typed-Value refactor is bigger than its byte count suggests.
- **(rejected) `typed_json_format` first** — Envoy's typed JSON encoder emits numbers/bools/null UNQUOTED. Plain `json_format` (all values as JSON strings) is the strictly-smaller leaf; `typed_json_format` is the natural additive follow-up over the SAME JSON encoder (it adds per-value type-inference, no new envelope). Picking plain `json_format` first is the correct decomposition.

**Decision.** Land `json_format` as a single phase `38-accesslog-json-format` per the SPEC at `docs/envoy-rust/phases/38-accesslog-json-format/SPEC.md`. Widen `SubstitutionFormatString` (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:697`) from a single-field struct into a `{text_format_source | json_format}` oneof + an exactly-one validator (the `DataSource` "exactly one of {filename, inline_string}" cardinality pattern is the template); model `json_format` as an insertion-order-preserving map of string key → command-operator value string (projected `Vec<(String, String)>` — key ordering is byte-load-bearing). Add a JSON encoder to `envoy-accesslog` that compiles each value via the EXISTING `parse_format` and assembles a single-line JSON object (key + value JSON-escaped, compact separators, the per-object terminator); it slots into the existing `FileSink.format` field (or its widened type) with `FileSink::emit` UNCHANGED. Each value string is config-load-validated via the EXISTING per-value `parse_format` → the EXISTING `ConfigError::InvalidAccessLogFormat` (projected NO new `ConfigError` variant; a small cardinality/empty-map variant only if §6.2 forces it). Fixture `0046` exercises a byte-exact JSON access-log line over a curated DETERMINISTIC operator set; the in-process backstop carries the richer cases (key-order preservation, JSON escaping, absent-value rendering, the text-path-unchanged round-trip). Minimum-viable per §2 — defers `typed_json_format`, nested/non-string values, `json_format_options`(sort)/`omit_empty_values`/`content_type`, the deprecated `text_format`/`format` scalars, any new record field/operator, and the other Observability surfaces (gRPC ALS, OTLP, tracing, stats sinks, tap).

**Rationale.** It is the cheapest pick that (a) opens the byte-exact Observability access-log-encoder vein (the prerequisite/sibling for the future gRPC-ALS/OTLP structured sinks), (b) needs ZERO new infrastructure (a new output envelope over an engine + a record + a sink + a harness that all already exist), (c) is byte-exact + deterministic + locally observable with genuine differential richness (the JSON envelope), (d) reuses the entire phase-32 engine + the `AccessLogRecord` + the `FileSink` + the `0040`/`0041`/`0042` byte-exact access-log harness, (e) needs no new crate/dependency/`HttpFilterInstance` variant. One strong differential for ~6–9 tasks. It was twice pre-identified as the deferred next leaf (ADR-0078 §2.2, ADR-0089).

**Consequences.** The state-2 PLAN-write (`superpowers:writing-plans`) runs the §6.2 LOCAL reconnaissance against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (an H1 listener + a `log_format.json_format` file logger) and fires **ADR-0092** (reserved) with the locked facts. The KEY §6.2 risks: (1) **JSON key ordering** — config insertion order (projected → `Vec<(String,String)>`) vs alphabetical (would force a sort); the single most load-bearing fact for byte-exactness; (2) **string-vs-typed value emission** — does plain `json_format` quote ALL values incl. numeric operators (`%RESPONSE_CODE%` → `"200"`, projected) or type-infer (which would blur the `typed_json_format` deferral and could fire the split); (3) the separators (compact, projected), the per-object trailing `\n` (projected), the absent-value rendering inside a JSON value (the `-` string, projected), and the JSON string-escaping rules; (4) the config-validity dispositions (empty `json_format` map, both arms set at once, malformed value-operator — boot-fatal, ADR-0049). **ADR-0093 is reserved** for the §6.1 split (projected NOT to fire — fires only if §6.2 reveals the JSON shape is far gnarlier than projected, e.g. plain `json_format` type-infers; the natural seam is `38.1` config schema + oneof + validator / `38.2` JSON encoder + `FileSink` wiring + fixture `0046` + close). The new ROADMAP row `38` lands `in-progress` (depends-on `06 32`). Carry-forwards: **M37-2** (the `lower_principal` `url_path` arm untested end-to-end) is NOT folded — `json_format` does not touch `rbac.rs` — so it stays live alongside **M37-1** (`#fragment` codec-400), **M36-1** (unanchored SafeRegex partial-vs-full), M36-2/M36-3, M34-1/M34-2/M34-3, M33-1/M33-2, the empty-`metadata_match` doc-comment, M29-1/M29-2, M30-1/M30-2, the phase-31 cosmetics, and the HTTP-filters-family (1)-(4). No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only). `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds; no new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant projected (NO new `ConfigError` variant projected — a small cardinality/empty-map variant is a §3 PLAN-write call). **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0091** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 91; next-available **ADR-0092**, reserved for the §6.2 reconciliation). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. The state-2 PLAN-write is the next session.

## ADR-0092: Phase-38 §6.2 reconciliation — the `json_format` JSON wire shape EMPIRICALLY LOCKED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0`; **FIRES** with FOUR material divergences from the ADR-0091/SPEC projection (key ordering SORTED not insertion; values TYPE-INFERRED not all-strings; `typed_json_format` is NOT a v1.33.0 field [the typed behavior is inherent to plain `json_format`]; empty `json_format` is VALID not fatal) — `BTreeMap<String,String>` config model + a per-operator typed-value classifier + an exactly-one-of validator; **ADR-0093 (the §6.1 split) does NOT fire**

**Status:** Accepted (phase-38 state-2 PLAN-write; `superpowers:writing-plans`). Consumes the **ADR-0092** number ADR-0091 reserved for the §6.2 reconciliation. Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0091 (the phase-38 pick + projected scope), ADR-0078/0079 (the phase-32 command-operator engine + the `text_format_source` wire path + the verbatim-`FileSink` newline rule), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal). **This ADR FIRES** — the reconnaissance materially overturns the SPEC's central projections; the PLAN is authored against the locked facts below (no `[§6.2-PENDING]` projections survive).

**Context.** Phase-38 (`38-accesslog-json-format`) adds the `json_format` output mode on `envoy.extensions.access_loggers.file.v3.FileAccessLog`. ADR-0091/SPEC §3/§6.2 projected the JSON shape but explicitly deferred the load-bearing facts (above all the **key ordering** and the **string-vs-typed value emission**) to this state-2 empirical reconnaissance. The reconnaissance stood up the pinned image `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (digest `sha256:56da5afd…0c2`) in Docker with an H1 listener + a `direct_response` route + a file access logger configured `log_format.json_format`, drove fixed requests, and scraped the log file — plus isolated per-case containers (full teardown between, per the phase-37 ADR-0090 leftover-container lesson) for the config-validity dispositions.

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live v1.33.0; the differential contract is the observation, not memory — D-3.3).**

**§A — KEY ORDERING = SORTED (ASCII byte order), NOT config insertion order. [DIVERGES — reverses SPEC §2.1.1/§3.1/§5; the single most load-bearing fact.]** Configuring keys in a deliberately non-alphabetical order (`zebra, method, alpha, status, …`) emitted them strictly sorted (`absent_hdr, alpha, bytes_recv, …, zebra`). A second probe with keys `0dig, Bcap, Zcap, acap` emitted `0dig` (0x30) < `Bcap` (0x42) < `Zcap` (0x5A) < `acap` (0x61) — i.e. **lexicographic by UTF-8 bytes** (digits < uppercase < lowercase). This is EXACTLY Rust's `Ord for String` (and thus `BTreeMap<String, _>` iteration order). → **The config model is `BTreeMap<String, String>`, NOT the projected `Vec<(String,String)>` insertion-order model.** This is SIMPLER than projected: serde deserializes a YAML map straight into `BTreeMap` (no custom `Deserialize`/`visit_map`), iteration is already sorted, and `BTreeMap<String>`'s byte-lexicographic order matches Envoy's emitted order for ASCII keys with ZERO extra work and ZERO new dependency. (Envoy's `json_format_options.sort_properties` knob — which would toggle this — is a deferred non-goal; the observed default IS sorted.)

**§B — VALUES ARE TYPE-INFERRED, NOT all-strings. [DIVERGES — reverses SPEC §2.1.2(a)/§3.2; the trigger condition §6.1 named.]** Plain `json_format` in v1.33.0 emits per value:
- a value that is **EXACTLY one command operator** (no literals, single segment) → the operator's NATIVE JSON type:
  - **numeric** operator present → an **unquoted JSON number**: `%RESPONSE_CODE%`→`200`, `%BYTES_SENT%`→`2`, `%BYTES_RECEIVED%`→`0`, `%DURATION%`→`0`.
  - **string** operator present → a **quoted JSON string**: `%REQ(:METHOD)%`→`"GET"`, `%PROTOCOL%`→`"HTTP/1.1"`, `%RESPONSE_FLAGS%`→`"-"`.
  - operator **absent / no value** → JSON **`null`** (NOT the `-` sentinel): `%REQ(X-ABSENT)%`→`null`, `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` (direct_response)→`null`, `%RESP(X-ENVOY-UPSTREAM-SERVICE-TIME)%` absent→`null`.
- a value containing **any literal text or >1 segment** → a **quoted JSON string** rendered through the EXISTING engine (absent operator → the `-` sentinel WITHIN the string): `code-%RESPONSE_CODE%`→`"code-200"`, `x=%REQ(X-ABSENT)%`→`"x=-"`.
- a **literal-only** value → a quoted string (a literal `"1"` stays `"1"`, NOT a number — only OPERATORS are typed).

→ **Type inference is MANDATORY this phase to be byte-exact** (the fixture line contains `"status":200` unquoted and `"upstream":null`). It is NOT deferrable. The encoder needs a per-operator typed-value classifier (number / string / null) over the single-operator case + the existing string-render path for the mixed case.

**§C — `typed_json_format` is NOT a field on `SubstitutionFormatString` in v1.33.0. [CORRECTS SPEC §2.2 — it deferred a NON-EXISTENT field.]** Configuring `log_format.typed_json_format:` is boot-fatal: `no such field: 'typed_json_format'`. v1.33.0's `SubstitutionFormatString` oneof is `{text_format (deprecated), json_format, text_format_source}` plus the scalar knobs `omit_empty_values`/`content_type`/`json_format_options`/`formatters`. The typed single-operator emission (§B) is INHERENT to plain `json_format` — there is no separate "typed" encoder to defer. → The SPEC §2.2 "`typed_json_format` deferred" bullet is **VOID**; type inference is folded INTO this phase. The genuine deferrals are re-drawn (§ Scope below).

**§D — Separators / terminator / escaping. [CONFIRMED + sharpened.]** Compact separators (`{"k":v,"k2":v2}`, no spaces) — CONFIRMED. One trailing `\n` per object (JSONL) — CONFIRMED. JSON string-escaping observed: `"`→`\"`, `\`→`\\`, newline→`\n`, tab→`\t` (short escapes); forward slash `/` **NOT** escaped (`"/recon"`, `"a/b"`); non-ASCII emitted as **raw UTF-8 verbatim** (`café`→bytes `c a f 0xC3 0xA9`, NOT `é`). This is byte-identical to `serde_json`'s default `String` serialization (short escapes for `\b\t\n\f\r\"\\`, `\u00XX` for other C0 controls, verbatim UTF-8, slash unescaped). → The encoder hand-rolls this escaper (consistent with `envoy-accesslog`'s dependency-free hand-rolled posture — the command-operator engine + the ISO-8601 formatter are both hand-rolled; **NO new dependency**, honoring D-3.2 / SPEC §7). The fixture stays in the unambiguous-ASCII subset; the escaping edges (quote/backslash/control/non-ASCII) are locked in the in-process backstop, not the cross-proxy fixture.

**§E — Config-validity dispositions (isolated per-case containers; full teardown between). [one DIVERGES, rest CONFIRMED.]**
- **empty `json_format: {}` → VALID, boots, emits `{}\n` (3 bytes). [DIVERGES — SPEC §3.4 projected it MAY be boot-fatal.]** → envoy-rust MUST accept an empty map and emit `{}\n`; **NO `EmptyJsonFormat` ConfigError variant.**
- **both `{text_format_source, json_format}` set → BOOT-FATAL** (`'json_format' has already been set … as part of a oneof`).
- **neither arm set** (an empty `SubstitutionFormatString` `{}`) → **BOOT-FATAL** (`field: "format", reason: is required`).
  → §E maps to the EXISTING `validate_data_source` exactly-one-of cardinality template (`bootstrap.rs:4442`, the `has_a == has_b` → error shape): **exactly one of `{text_format_source, json_format}` must be set**; boot-fatal on BOTH-set AND NEITHER-set.
- **unknown key under `log_format` → BOOT-FATAL** (`no such field: 'bogus_key'`) — envoy-rust's existing `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` on `SubstitutionFormatString` already matches (surfaces as `ConfigError::Yaml`).
- **malformed operator in a value (`%NOPE%`) → BOOT-FATAL** (`Not supported field in StreamInfo: NOPE`) — envoy-rust reuses the per-value `envoy_accesslog::parse_format` validator → the EXISTING `ConfigError::InvalidAccessLogFormat { detail }` (same response class per §7.4; identical text not required).
- **ConfigError disposition:** reuse `InvalidAccessLogFormat` for per-value parse failures; add **ONE** new focused variant for the §E exactly-one cardinality (both-set / neither-set). All boot-fatal (ADR-0049; no reload path this phase).

**§F — Authoritative fixture-`0046` line (byte-exact, captured live).** An H1 `direct_response: {status: 200, body: "ok\n"}` route + the json_format `{method:%REQ(:METHOD)%, path:%REQ(:PATH)%, protocol:%PROTOCOL%, status:%RESPONSE_CODE%, flags:%RESPONSE_FLAGS%, bytes_rcvd:%BYTES_RECEIVED%, bytes_sent:%BYTES_SENT%, upstream:%UPSTREAM_HOST%, mixed:code-%RESPONSE_CODE%}`, driven by a bare `GET /` (Host `envoy-rust.test`), emits exactly (sorted keys; number/string/null/mixed all exercised; deterministic — no timing/id operator):
`{"bytes_rcvd":0,"bytes_sent":3,"flags":"-","method":"GET","mixed":"code-200","path":"/","protocol":"HTTP/1.1","status":200,"upstream":null}\n`

**Decision.** Lock §A–§F. **Config model:** widen `SubstitutionFormatString` to `{ text_format_source: Option<DataSourceInline>, json_format: Option<BTreeMap<String,String>> }` (`deny_unknown_fields` retained) + an exactly-one-of validator (boot-fatal both/neither) + the per-value `parse_format` loop + ONE new `ConfigError` cardinality variant. **Encoder:** a NEW sibling compiled type `CompiledJsonFormat` (a `BTreeMap<String, Vec<Segment>>`, each value compiled via the EXISTING `parse_format`) with its own `render(&AccessLogRecord) -> String` that, per sorted key, classifies the value (single-operator-typed → number/string/null via a new per-`Op` typed-value classifier; else the existing string-render with the `-` sentinel) and assembles `{…}` with a hand-rolled JSON key/string escaper + the trailing `\n`. **FileSink factoring (resolves SPEC §3.4(a)):** a NEW `LogFormat` enum (`Text(CompiledFormat) | Json(CompiledJsonFormat)`) on `FileSink.format` with `impl From<CompiledFormat>`/`From<CompiledJsonFormat>` so existing `FileSink::new(path, CompiledFormat…)` call sites keep compiling via `Into` — the existing `CompiledFormat` and its `render` are LEFT BYTE-UNTOUCHED (the text/default path is frozen; the 45 existing fixtures stay green). The H1 `compiled_log_format` (`envoy-http1/src/hcm.rs:1254`) returns `LogFormat` (Text-or-Json arm); the H2 default site passes `LogFormat::Text(CompiledFormat::default())`.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0093 stays UNFIRED).** The type inference (§B) adds a per-`Op` typed-value classifier (~80–120 LoC) over the projected, but the surface stays ONE config arm + ONE encoder over the EXISTING engine/record/sink/harness — no new request attribute, no new infrastructure, no new crate/dependency. Estimate **~9 TDD tasks / ~650–900 LoC net** — under the §6.1 ~25-task / ~1500-LoC gate. **ADR-0093 stays available** for a future split trigger.

**Scope correction (supersedes the §2.2 framing of ADR-0091/SPEC).** IN this phase (additions vs the SPEC projection): the `BTreeMap` sorted config model (§A); the per-operator type inference number/string/null (§B); the exactly-one-of validator + one new cardinality `ConfigError` variant (§E); accept-and-emit empty `json_format` → `{}\n` (§E). The genuine DEFERRALS (each its own future home): `json_format_options.sort_properties` (we hardcode the observed sorted default); `omit_empty_values`; `content_type`; nested / non-string `Struct` values (lists, nested objects); the deprecated `text_format` scalar; any new `AccessLogRecord` field / operator. (The §2.2 "`typed_json_format`" bullet is VOID per §C.)

**Consequences.** `PLAN.md` is authored against §A–§F inline (no projections). NO new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant (the existing `parse_bootstrap` + `accesslog_format_parse` fuzz targets cover the new surface — a `json_format` `parse_bootstrap` seed is added; NO new fuzz target). ONE new `ConfigError` variant (the §E cardinality). `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds (D-3.8). Carry-forwards unchanged — `json_format` does not touch `rbac.rs`, so **M37-2/M37-1/M36-1/M36-2/M36-3/M34-*/M33-*** + the older Minors stay live un-folded. **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0092** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 92; next-available **ADR-0093**, RESERVED for the §6.1 split which this ADR confirms does NOT fire — stays available). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. The state-3 implementation is the next session (`superpowers:executing-plans` / `subagent-driven-development`, TDD per task).

## ADR-0093: Phase-39 pick + scope — **deepen the byte-exact `json_format` access-log encoder to RECURSIVE `Struct` values** (nested JSON objects + lists, the way Envoy's `SubstitutionFormatString.json_format` is a full `google.protobuf.Struct`) over the EXISTING phase-38 `CompiledJsonFormat` encoder + `AccessLogRecord` + `FileSink` + harness — a recursion refactor with ZERO new connection-context plumbing, ZERO new request attribute, NO new operator, and NO new `HttpFilterInstance` variant / crate / dependency; choose nested `json_format` over the rejected alternatives below + fixture `0047`

**Status:** Accepted (phase-39 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `39-accesslog-json-nested-values`. **Consumes the ADR-0093 number** that ADR-0092 reserved for the phase-38 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 38 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0093` is genuinely the next-free number; this ADR consumes it for the phase-39 pick (the same reclaim-a-lapsed-reservation convention by which ADR-0091 reclaimed the number ADR-0090 had reserved). Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0091/0092 (the phase-38 `json_format` pick + the §6.2 reconciliation that locked the FLAT JSON wire shape — keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes [`BTreeMap`]; values type-inferred number/string/null; `typed_json_format` is NOT a v1.33.0 field; empty `json_format` VALID `{}\n`; one `ConfigError::AmbiguousLogFormat` cardinality variant), ADR-0078/0079 (the phase-32 command-operator engine + the verbatim-`FileSink` newline rule), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal).

**Context.** Phases 32–38 ran the Observability/HTTP-filters vein: phase 32 built the access-log command-operator engine + the `text_format_source` TEXT format; 33/34 added the dynamic-metadata store + `%DYNAMIC_METADATA%`; 35/36/37 ran the RBAC `metadata`/`present_match`/`safe_regex`/`url_path` conditions; phase 38 (ADR-0091/0092) landed the `json_format` output mode as a FLAT map — `json_format: Option<BTreeMap<String, String>>` (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:708`) compiled into `CompiledJsonFormat(BTreeMap<String, Vec<Segment>>)` (`crates/envoy-accesslog/src/json_format.rs:14`) rendering ONE flat sorted JSON object per request, with per-leaf type inference (single numeric op→unquoted number, single string op→quoted string, single absent op→`null`, mixed/literal→quoted string with `-`) all locked byte-exact vs v1.33.0. But Envoy's `json_format` is a recursive `google.protobuf.Struct`: a value may itself be a nested OBJECT (another key→value map) or a LIST, to arbitrary depth — and ADR-0092's Scope-correction EXPLICITLY DEFERRED "nested / non-string `Struct` values (lists, nested objects)" to its own future home. ROADMAP rows `00`–`38` are all `done`; `38` was the highest defined row; the remaining family headings (`Runtime + hot restart`, `WASM host`, `Deprecated/edge`) are headings-only → this is a free new-phase pick. **Important correction the recon already settled:** the phase-38 STATE.md candidate menu framed the follow-up as "`typed_json_format` / non-string JSON values (typed unquoted values, nested/non-string `Struct` values)" — but ADR-0092 §B/§C discovered the TYPED (unquoted number/string/null) behavior is INHERENT to plain `json_format` and was ALREADY DELIVERED in phase 38, and `typed_json_format` is NOT a real v1.33.0 field. So the genuinely-remaining cheapest-strong follow-up over the SAME encoder is the RECURSION (nested objects + lists), which this phase picks.

**Options considered (the pick rationale + rejected alternatives):**
- **(CHOSEN) nested / non-string `json_format` (`Struct`) values.** Make the phase-38 config model + `CompiledJsonFormat` encoder RECURSIVE — a value may be a format string (the phase-38 leaf, unchanged), a nested object, or a list, to arbitrary depth; sorted keys at each object level, list order preserved, the SAME per-leaf type inference at every depth. It REUSES the entire phase-32 engine + the `AccessLogRecord` + the `FileSink`/`LogFormat` + the hand-rolled JSON escaper + the per-`Op` type classifier (`encode_single_op`) + the `Driver::Http1WithAccessLog`/`AccessLogByteExactProbe` harness; the only new code is the structural recursion (a recursive config enum + a recursive compiled enum + a recursive `render`). ZERO new connection-context plumbing, ZERO new request attribute, NO metadata store, NO producer chain, NO new operator, NO new `HttpFilterInstance` variant / crate / dependency, projected NO new `ConfigError` variant. Byte-exact + deterministic + locally observable (an access-log scrape on a normal request/response, NOT Linux-CI-only); genuine differential richness via the RECURSION (the deterministic operators phase 38 proved byte-exact in a FLAT object must now render byte-exact inside NESTED objects + lists). ~350–600 LoC / ~6–8 tasks — the cheapest-strong leaf, SMALLER than phase 38.
- **(rejected) `omit_empty_values`** — Envoy's knob to DROP keys whose rendered value is empty/absent. A cheaper but WEAKER differential (a key-presence toggle, not new structure), and the "empty" definition has its own §6.2 subtlety. Its own future Observability-knob phase.
- **(rejected) `json_format_options.sort_properties`** — the knob to TOGGLE the per-object key sorting. The observed v1.33.0 default IS sorted (ADR-0092 §A) and is already what phase 38/39 emit; the disable-sorting path is a smaller, weaker additive boolean. Its own future phase.
- **(rejected) `content_type`** — overriding the emitted content-type; it does not affect the scraped log LINE (weakly differentially observable via a file scrape). Its own future phase.
- **(rejected) the connection-context RBAC conditions** (`destination_ip`/`destination_port`/`source_ip`/`direct_remote_ip`/`remote_ip`/`requested_server_name`-SNI) — EACH needs the downstream socket address (and, for SNI, the TLS handshake server-name) threaded into `FilterRequest` (new plumbing) + a CIDR/IP matcher. Heavier per unit of differential strength than nested `json_format`'s zero-plumbing recursion. Its own future RBAC-condition phase once a connection-context plumbing slice lands. (Would have folded carry-forward M37-2; nested `json_format` does not touch `rbac.rs`, so M37-2 stays live.)
- **(rejected) the remaining non-string `ValueMatcher` variants** (`null`/`double`/`bool`/`list`/`or`) + `MetadataMatcher.invert` + multi-segment metadata `path` — the matcher-VALUE axis the non-string-Value generalization gates. Lower differential-strength-per-LoC, and the typed-Value refactor is bigger than its byte count suggests.

**Decision.** Land nested `json_format` as a single phase `39-accesslog-json-nested-values` per the SPEC at `docs/envoy-rust/phases/39-accesslog-json-nested-values/SPEC.md`. Replace the flat `json_format` value type `String` with a recursive enum `JsonFormatValue = Format(String) | Object(BTreeMap<String, JsonFormatValue>) | Array(Vec<JsonFormatValue>)` (serde `#[serde(untagged)]`; `json_format: Option<BTreeMap<String, JsonFormatValue>>`, the top level stays a key→value map as Envoy's `Struct` is); `deny_unknown_fields`, the exactly-one-of `{text_format_source, json_format}` validator (`ConfigError::AmbiguousLogFormat`), and the empty-top-map acceptance (`{}\n`) are UNCHANGED. Widen `CompiledJsonFormat` to a recursive `CompiledJsonValue = Leaf(Vec<Segment>) | Object(BTreeMap<String, CompiledJsonValue>) | Array(Vec<CompiledJsonValue>)` compiled via the EXISTING `parse_format` per leaf, with a recursive `render` that emits sorted `{…}` objects + ordered `[…]` lists and REUSES the phase-38 leaf helpers (`encode_json_value`/`encode_single_op`/`json_escape_into`/`quote*`) VERBATIM; the top-level object keeps the trailing `\n`. The config validator recurses the tree and calls `parse_format` per LEAF → the EXISTING `ConfigError::InvalidAccessLogFormat` (projected NO new variant). `FileSink`/`LogFormat` (defined in `crates/envoy-accesslog/src/log_format.rs`, held by `FileSink.format`) and the H1/H2 `compiled_log_format` wiring (`crates/envoy-http1/src/hcm.rs:1254`, the `(None, Some(map))` arm at `:1269`) are UNCHANGED except `CompiledJsonFormat::from_map`'s argument type. Fixture `0047` exercises a byte-exact NESTED JSON access-log line (a nested object + a list over a curated DETERMINISTIC operator set); the in-process backstop carries the richer cases (per-level key-sorting, list-order preservation, at-depth type inference, JSON escaping at depth, empty `{}`/`[]`, depth ≥3, the flat-map round-trip byte-unchanged). Minimum-viable per §2 — defers `json_format_options.sort_properties`, `omit_empty_values`, `content_type`, non-string SCALAR typed leaves beyond fixture/backstop need, the deprecated `text_format`/`format` scalars, any new record field/operator, and the other Observability surfaces (gRPC ALS, OTLP, tracing, stats sinks, tap).

**Rationale.** It is the cheapest pick that (a) deepens the byte-exact Observability access-log-encoder vein (nested `Struct` support is the prerequisite for the future gRPC-ALS/OTLP structured sinks, which emit nested JSON), (b) needs ZERO new infrastructure (a recursion refactor over an engine + a record + a sink + a harness + a leaf-encoder that all already exist), (c) is byte-exact + deterministic + locally observable with genuine differential richness (the recursion), (d) reuses the entire phase-32 engine + the phase-38 JSON leaf encoder + the `AccessLogRecord` + the `FileSink` + the `0040`/`0046` byte-exact access-log harness, (e) needs no new crate/dependency/operator/`HttpFilterInstance` variant. One strong differential for ~6–8 tasks. It is the exact follow-up ADR-0092's Scope-correction named ("nested / non-string `Struct` values (lists, nested objects)").

**Consequences.** No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only). The state-2 PLAN-write (`superpowers:writing-plans`) runs the §6.2 LOCAL reconnaissance against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (an H1 listener + a NESTED `log_format.json_format` file logger) and fires **ADR-0094** (reserved) with the locked facts. The KEY §6.2 risks: (1) **the non-string scalar leaf disposition** — a bare YAML number/bool/null `Struct` value (not a format string) emitted typed, stringified, or rejected (decides whether `JsonFormatValue` needs a typed-`Scalar` arm); (2) **the recursive wire shape** — keys sorted at EVERY object level (projected — `BTreeMap` byte-order applied recursively), list element order = config order (projected, NOT sorted), the SAME per-leaf type inference at depth (projected), compact separators + ONE trailing `\n` on the whole top-level object (projected, no inter-element `\n`); (3) the degenerate-nesting dispositions (empty nested object `{}`, empty list `[]`, a list with an absent-operator leaf). **ADR-0095 is reserved** for the §6.1 split (projected NOT to fire — ~350–600 LoC / ~6–8 tasks, under the ~1500-LoC/~25-task gate; fires only if §6.2 reveals the recursive shape is far gnarlier than projected, e.g. non-string scalar leaves demand a full typed-`Value` model; the natural seam, if forced, is `39.1` recursive config model + serde + validator + parse-layer tests / `39.2` recursive encoder + fixture `0047` + BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT + seed + close). The new ROADMAP row `39` lands `in-progress` (depends-on `06 32 38`). Carry-forwards: nested `json_format` does NOT touch `rbac.rs`, so **M37-2** (the `lower_principal` `url_path` arm untested end-to-end), **M37-1** (`#fragment` codec-400), **M36-1** (unanchored SafeRegex partial-vs-full), M36-2/M36-3, M34-1/M34-2/M34-3, M33-1/M33-2, the empty-`metadata_match` doc-comment, M29-1/M29-2, M30-1/M30-2, the phase-31 cosmetics, and the HTTP-filters-family (1)-(4) all stay live un-folded; the phase-38 Minors **M38-1** (duplicated Req/Resp resolve+truncate across text/JSON render paths — `json_format.rs`/`command_operator.rs`) and **M38-4** (typed-JSON-path test gaps) and **M38-3** (empty-value-string edge) ARE in phase 39's surface (`json_format.rs`) and SHOULD be folded by the implementation where the recursion touches the leaf path; **M38-2** (`%DYNAMIC_METADATA%` single-op JSON quoting cross-proxy) is adjacent and may be confirmed in the §6.2 recon. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds; no new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant projected (NO new `ConfigError` variant projected). **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0093** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 93; next-available **ADR-0094**, reserved for the §6.2 reconciliation). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. The state-2 PLAN-write is the next session.

## ADR-0094: Phase-39 §6.2 reconciliation — the nested / recursive `json_format` JSON wire shape EMPIRICALLY LOCKED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0`; **FIRES** — the recursion projection (per-level key sorting, list-order preservation, at-depth type inference, compact separators + one trailing `\n`) is CONFIRMED across the board, with ONE material refinement (non-string SCALAR leaves emit as NATIVE TYPED JSON — `bool`/`null` byte-exact-and-IN, NUMERIC literals a protobuf-double formatting rabbit hole DEFERRED as a carry-forward) and NO new `ConfigError` variant; **ADR-0095 (the §6.1 split) does NOT fire**

**Status:** Accepted (phase-39 state-2 PLAN-write; `superpowers:writing-plans`). Consumes the **ADR-0094** number ADR-0093 reserved for the §6.2 reconciliation. Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0093 (the phase-39 pick + projected recursion scope), ADR-0091/0092 (the phase-38 FLAT `json_format` wire shape — keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes [`BTreeMap`]; per-leaf type inference number/string/null; compact separators + trailing `\n` + hand-rolled escaping; empty `json_format` VALID `{}\n`; one `ConfigError::AmbiguousLogFormat` cardinality variant), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal). **This ADR FIRES** — the recon CONFIRMS the SPEC's recursion projection but materially REFINES the non-string-scalar disposition (SPEC §3.1 leaned toward "rendered as a Format-string-equivalent"; the truth is native-typed emission), so the PLAN is authored against the locked facts below.

**Context.** Phase-39 (`39-accesslog-json-nested-values`) makes the phase-38 `json_format` access-log encoder RECURSIVE (nested objects + lists as `google.protobuf.Struct` values). ADR-0093/SPEC §3/§6.2 projected the recursive shape but explicitly deferred the load-bearing facts (per-level sorting, list-order, at-depth type inference, and above all the non-string SCALAR leaf disposition) to this state-2 empirical reconnaissance. The reconnaissance stood up the pinned image `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (digest `sha256:56da5afd…0c2`) in Docker with an H1 listener + a `direct_response` route + a file access logger configured with a NESTED `log_format.json_format`, drove a bare `GET /` (Host `recon.test`), and scraped `/tmp/access.log` (with `od -c` for exact trailing bytes) — across five cases (comprehensive nested; non-string scalars + empties; malformed nested operator; numeric-literal formatting; depth-3 + list-of-objects), with full container teardown between (the phase-37 ADR-0090 leftover-container lesson).

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live v1.33.0; the differential contract is the observation, not memory — D-3.3).**

**§A — PER-LEVEL KEY SORTING = SORTED (UTF-8 byte order) at EVERY object level. [CONFIRMED — extends ADR-0092 §A recursively.]** CASE-1 configured top keys `zouter, arequest, blist, mtop` and nested-object keys `method, zpath, aaa`; the emitted line was `{"arequest":{"aaa":200,"method":"GET","zpath":"/"},"blist":[…],"mtop":…,"zouter":…}` — BOTH the top level AND the nested object are independently sorted by byte order. → Each object level is a `BTreeMap<String, _>` (sorted iteration); the recursion sorts at every depth with ZERO extra work.

**§B — LIST ELEMENT ORDER = CONFIG ORDER (NOT sorted). [CONFIRMED.]** CASE-1's `blist: [%REQ(:METHOD)%, %RESPONSE_CODE%, %UPSTREAM_HOST%]` emitted `["GET",200,null]` — config order preserved, NOT sorted. → Lists are `Vec<_>` (ordered); only objects sort.

**§C — AT-DEPTH TYPE INFERENCE = the SAME per-leaf rule as phase 38 (ADR-0092 §B), applied at every depth. [CONFIRMED.]** A format-string leaf at any depth: single numeric operator → unquoted number (`aaa: "%RESPONSE_CODE%"` nested → `200`; `%RESPONSE_CODE%` in a list → `200`; `d3: "%RESPONSE_CODE%"` at depth-3 → `200`); single string operator → quoted string (`method: "%REQ(:METHOD)%"` → `"GET"`); single absent operator → `null` (`%UPSTREAM_HOST%` in a list → `null`); mixed/literal → quoted string with the `-` sentinel (`mtop: "code-%RESPONSE_CODE%"` → `"code-200"`). → The EXISTING `encode_json_value`/`encode_single_op` leaf helpers (phase 38, `json_format.rs`) are reused VERBATIM at every recursion leaf; the recursion adds only the `{…}`/`[…]` structural envelope.

**§D — NON-STRING SCALAR LEAVES emit as NATIVE TYPED JSON (NOT stringified, NOT format strings). [MATERIAL REFINEMENT — SPEC §3.1 projected "rendered as a Format-string-equivalent".]** A `google.protobuf.Struct` value carries a KIND; only `string_value` is treated as a command-operator format string. CASE-2 (`num: 42 / boolt: true / nul: null / emptyobj: {} / emptylist: [] / s: "%PROTOCOL%"`) emitted exactly (od-confirmed, single trailing `\n`):
`{"boolt":true,"emptylist":[],"emptyobj":{},"nul":null,"num":42,"s":"HTTP/1.1"}` + `\n`
— `true`→`true`, `null`→`null`, `42`→`42` all NATIVE TYPED (unquoted), `{}`→`{}`, `[]`→`[]`, the string leaf `"%PROTOCOL%"`→`"HTTP/1.1"`. **BUT numeric literals route through protobuf's `double` (number_value) JSON serialization, which is a NON-PORTABLE formatting rabbit hole** (CASE-4 `zero: 0 / intg: 42 / flt: 1.5 / neg: -7 / big: 1000000` → `{"big":1e+06,"flt":"1.5","intg":42,"neg":-7,"zero":0}`): a large integer `1000000` → **`1e+06`** (scientific notation, double-backed), and `1.5` → **`"1.5"`** (a YAML→Struct parse quirk emits it as a quoted STRING, not a number). Replicating Envoy's exact double→JSON byte formatting (shortest-round-trip / scientific-notation thresholds / the `1.5`-string quirk) is disproportionate to the MVP. → **Decision: `bool` + `null` literal leaves are byte-exact and trivial → IN this phase; ALL NUMERIC literal leaves are DEFERRED as a named carry-forward (CF-39-1).** envoy-rust's config model accepts `string`(format) / `bool` / `null` / nested-object / list leaves; a NUMERIC literal leaf is NOT accepted (serde-untagged matches none → boot-reject) — a documented, narrow divergence (Envoy accepts a literal number in a `json_format` value; this is exotic — operators are strings — and `bool`/`null` cover the realistic constant-field cases). The fixture + backstop stay in the byte-exact subset {format-string, nested object, list, `bool`, `null`}.

**§E — Separators / terminator / nesting whitespace. [CONFIRMED + sharpened.]** Compact separators (`{"k":v,"k2":v2}` / `[a,b,c]`, NO spaces) at every level — CONFIRMED. Exactly ONE trailing `\n` on the WHOLE top-level object (CASE-2 od: `… "}` `\n`, offset 0000117 = 79 bytes incl the `\n`) — CONFIRMED; NO inter-element / inter-level `\n` (the nested objects/lists are inline). → The recursion emits the structure inline; only the top-level `render` appends the single `\n` (the phase-38 `CompiledJsonFormat::render` trailing-`\n` rule, unchanged).

**§F — Degenerate nesting. [CONFIRMED.]** Empty nested object `{}` → `{}`; empty list `[]` → `[]` (CASE-2). A list containing an absent-operator leaf → `null` in place (CASE-1 `["GET",200,null]`). → All valid; emitted as the natural empty/typed token.

**§G — Config validity. [CONFIRMED.]** A malformed operator in a NESTED leaf (CASE-3 `a: { b: "%NOPE%" }`) → **BOOT-FATAL** (`Not supported field in StreamInfo: NOPE`). → envoy-rust recurses the tree and calls the EXISTING per-leaf `envoy_accesslog::parse_format` validator → the EXISTING `ConfigError::InvalidAccessLogFormat { detail }` (same response class per §7.4). The exactly-one-of `{text_format_source, json_format}` cardinality (`ConfigError::AmbiguousLogFormat`) and the empty-top-map acceptance (`{}\n`) are UNCHANGED from phase 38 (the recursion does not touch the oneof). → **NO new `ConfigError` variant** (confirms the SPEC §2.1.4 projection).

**§H — Authoritative fixture-`0047` line (byte-exact, captured live, CASE-1).** An H1 `direct_response: {status: 200, body: "ok\n"}` route + the nested json_format `{zouter:%PROTOCOL%, arequest:{method:%REQ(:METHOD)%, zpath:%REQ(:PATH)%, aaa:%RESPONSE_CODE%}, blist:[%REQ(:METHOD)%, %RESPONSE_CODE%, %UPSTREAM_HOST%], mtop:code-%RESPONSE_CODE%}`, driven by a bare `GET /` (Host `recon.test`), emits exactly (sorted keys at both levels; list order preserved; number/string/null/mixed all exercised; deterministic — no timing/id operator):
`{"arequest":{"aaa":200,"method":"GET","zpath":"/"},"blist":["GET",200,null],"mtop":"code-200","zouter":"HTTP/1.1"}\n`
The state-3 PLAN MAY enrich fixture `0047` with a `bool`/`null` literal leaf to exercise §D in the byte-exact line (deterministic); the escaping edges (quote/backslash/control/non-ASCII at depth) stay in the in-process backstop (the phase-38 `0046` discipline).

**Decision.** Lock §A–§H. **Config model:** replace the flat `json_format: Option<BTreeMap<String,String>>` with `json_format: Option<BTreeMap<String, JsonFormatValue>>` where `JsonFormatValue` is a `#[serde(untagged)]` enum `{ Null, Bool(bool), Format(String), Array(Vec<JsonFormatValue>), Object(BTreeMap<String, JsonFormatValue>) }` (untagged arm order chosen so YAML null→`Null`, bool→`Bool`, string→`Format`, seq→`Array`, map→`Object`; a numeric scalar matches NO arm → boot-reject, per §D/CF-39-1). `deny_unknown_fields`, the exactly-one-of validator (`AmbiguousLogFormat`), and the empty-top-map acceptance are UNCHANGED. **Encoder:** widen `CompiledJsonFormat` to compile + render a recursive `CompiledJsonValue` = `{ Null, Bool(bool), Leaf(Vec<Segment>), Array(Vec<CompiledJsonValue>), Object(BTreeMap<String, CompiledJsonValue>) }` — `Format` strings compile via the EXISTING `parse_format` to `Leaf`; `Bool`/`Null` carry the literal; `render` walks the tree (`Object`→sorted `{"k":v,…}` reusing `json_escape_into` for keys; `Array`→ordered `[v,…]`; `Leaf`→the EXISTING `encode_json_value`; `Bool`→`true`/`false`; `Null`→`null`), the top-level `render` appends the single `\n`. The phase-38 leaf helpers (`encode_json_value`/`encode_single_op`/`json_escape_into`/`quote*`) are REUSED VERBATIM. **FileSink/LogFormat/HCM:** UNCHANGED except `CompiledJsonFormat::from_map`'s argument type (ripples to `hcm.rs:1269` + the `bootstrap.rs` validator loop, which recurses the tree calling `parse_format` per `Leaf`). **Fixture `0047`** = the §H byte-exact nested line; the in-process backstop carries the richer cases (per-level sort, list order, at-depth inference, `bool`/`null` leaves, escaping at depth, empty `{}`/`[]`, depth-3, the `0046` flat round-trip byte-unchanged). NO new crate/dependency/fuzz-target (the recursive map reuses `parse_bootstrap`; each leaf string reuses `accesslog_format_parse`; a nested `parse_bootstrap` seed is added). NO new `ConfigError` variant.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0095 stays UNFIRED).** The recursion adds a recursive config enum + a recursive compiled enum + a recursive `render` (reusing all phase-38 leaf helpers) + the `bool`/`null` arms — the surface stays ONE config value type + ONE encoder over the EXISTING engine/record/sink/harness; no new request attribute, no new infrastructure. Estimate **~7 TDD tasks / ~350–550 LoC net** — under the §6.1 ~25-task / ~1500-LoC gate. **ADR-0095 stays available** for a future split trigger.

**Scope correction (refines the §2.2 framing of ADR-0093/SPEC).** IN this phase (vs the SPEC projection): the recursive config model + encoder over format-string leaves (§A–§C, §E–§G); PLUS `bool`/`null` literal leaves emitted native-typed (§D). The genuine DEFERRALS (each its own future home): **CF-39-1 — NUMERIC literal leaves** (the protobuf-`double` JSON formatting rabbit hole: `1e+06` scientific notation, the `1.5`→`"1.5"` quirk; envoy-rust boot-rejects a numeric literal `json_format` value until a future phase replicates protobuf double serialization); `json_format_options.sort_properties` (we hardcode the observed sorted default, recursively); `omit_empty_values`; `content_type`; the deprecated `text_format` scalar; any new `AccessLogRecord` field / operator.

**Consequences.** `PLAN.md` is authored against §A–§H inline (no `[§6.2-PENDING]` projections survive). NO new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant; NO new `ConfigError` variant. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds (D-3.8). Carry-forwards: **CF-39-1** (numeric literal leaves) is NEW. The phase-38 Minors **M38-1/M38-3/M38-4** are IN phase-39's surface (`json_format.rs`/`command_operator.rs`) and SHOULD be folded by the state-3 implementation where the recursion touches the leaf path; **M38-2** (`%DYNAMIC_METADATA%` single-op JSON quoting) was NOT separately reconnoitred here (no metadata in the recon configs) and stays live. `json_format` does not touch `rbac.rs`, so **M37-2/M37-1/M36-1/M36-2/M36-3/M34-*/M33-*** + the older Minors stay live un-folded. **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0094** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 94; next-available **ADR-0095**, RESERVED for the §6.1 split which this ADR confirms does NOT fire — stays available). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. The state-3 implementation is the next session (`superpowers:executing-plans` / `subagent-driven-development`, TDD per task).

## ADR-0095: Phase-40 pick + scope — **add the `omit_empty_values` knob to `SubstitutionFormatString`** (when `true`, the access logger OMITS entries whose substituted value is "empty") over the EXISTING phase-38/39 recursive `json_format` encoder + the existing `AccessLogRecord` + `FileSink` + harness — a config-knob + drop-empty-render-pass with ZERO new connection plumbing / request attribute / operator / crate / dependency, and projected NO new `ConfigError` variant; choose `omit_empty_values` over the rejected alternatives below + fixture `0048`

**Status:** Accepted (phase-40 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `40-accesslog-omit-empty-values`. **Consumes the ADR-0095 number** that ADR-0094 reserved for the phase-39 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 39 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0095` is the next-free number (the same reclaim-a-lapsed-reservation convention by which ADR-0093 reclaimed the phase-38 split slot and ADR-0091 the phase-37 slot). Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0091/0092 (the phase-38 `json_format` pick + the §6.2 reconciliation — which at §C empirically OBSERVED `omit_empty_values` on the live v1.33.0 `SubstitutionFormatString` oneof roster and named it a deferred knob) and ADR-0093/0094 (the phase-39 recursive `json_format` encoder), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal).

**Context.** Phases 32/38/39 ran the Observability access-log-encoder vein: phase 32 the text command-operator engine + `text_format_source`; phase 38 the `json_format` JSON-object output mode (keys sorted, values type-inferred); phase 39 made `json_format` recursive (nested objects + lists + `bool`/`null` leaves). ROADMAP rows `00`-`39` are all `done`; `39` was the highest defined row; the remaining family headings are headings-only → a free new-phase pick. ADR-0092 §C / ADR-0094 explicitly DEFERRED the remaining `SubstitutionFormatString` scalar knobs (`omit_empty_values`, `json_format_options.sort_properties`, `content_type`) to their own future homes; this phase picks up the strongest of them.

**Options considered (the pick rationale + rejected alternatives):**
- **(CHOSEN) `omit_empty_values`.** A `bool omit_empty_values` field on `SubstitutionFormatString` (serde default `false`) + a drop-empty pass over the EXISTING phase-38/39 `CompiledJsonFormat` encoder: when `true`, render DROPS each entry whose value is "empty"; when `false`, render is the phase-38/39 path VERBATIM. ZERO new connection plumbing, request attribute, operator, crate, dependency, `HttpFilterInstance` variant; projected NO new `ConfigError` variant. Byte-exact + deterministic + locally observable (an access-log scrape on a normal request/response, NOT Linux-CI-only); genuine differential richness via the drop-empty semantics (envoy-rust must drop EXACTLY the keys Envoy drops, per the §6.2 "empty" predicate, and re-assemble the survivors). ~150–350 LoC / ~5–7 tasks — the cheapest-strong leaf, SMALLER than phases 38/39.
- **(rejected) `json_format_options.sort_properties`** — the per-object key-sort toggle. The observed v1.33.0 default IS sorted (ADR-0092 §A, hardcoded recursively in phase 39), so the knob only adds the un-sort path — a WEAKER differential per LoC. Its own future phase.
- **(rejected) `content_type`** — the emitted content-type override; it does NOT change the scraped log LINE bytes (weakly differentially observable via a file scrape). Its own future phase.
- **(rejected) CF-39-1 numeric-literal `json_format` leaves** — replicating Envoy's protobuf-`double` JSON formatting (`1e+06` scientific / the `1.5`→`"1.5"` quirk) is a fiddly rabbit hole with low differential-strength-per-LoC. Stays a carry-forward.
- **(rejected) the other Observability surfaces** (gRPC ALS, OTLP access log, tracing, stats sinks, tap) — each needs NEW sink/transport infrastructure (a gRPC streaming sink, an OTLP exporter). Heavier per unit of differential strength than a render knob over the existing file sink. Each its own future family phase.
- **(rejected) the connection-context RBAC conditions / non-string `ValueMatcher` variants** — each needs new socket-address/SNI plumbing or a non-string-Value generalization. Heavier; their own future phases (would fold M37-2/M36-1).

**Decision.** Land `omit_empty_values` as a single phase `40-accesslog-omit-empty-values` per the SPEC at `docs/envoy-rust/phases/40-accesslog-omit-empty-values/SPEC.md`. Add `omit_empty_values: bool` (`#[serde(default)]`) to `SubstitutionFormatString` (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:704-709`; `deny_unknown_fields` retained; the exactly-one-of `{text_format_source, json_format}` validator UNCHANGED). Thread the flag into the compiled format (projected a field on `CompiledJsonFormat`/`LogFormat` set at construction) and add a drop-empty branch to the `json_format` render: when `true`, drop each entry whose rendered value is "empty" per the §6.2-locked predicate; when `false`, the phase-38/39 render verbatim. Fixture `0048-accesslog-omit-empty` exercises a present/absent key mix with `omit_empty_values: true` (empty keys dropped) + a flag-off all-keys control, whole-line byte-exact; the in-process backstop carries the predicate edges + the recursive disposition + the default-off round-trip. Minimum-viable per §2 — defers `sort_properties`, `content_type`, CF-39-1, the deprecated scalars, new record fields/operators, the other Observability surfaces, and (if §6.2 shows it heavy) the `text_format` interaction.

**Rationale.** The cheapest pick that (a) continues the byte-exact Observability access-log-encoder vein, (b) needs ZERO new infrastructure (a render knob over an encoder + record + sink + harness that all exist), (c) is byte-exact + deterministic + locally observable with genuine differential richness (the drop-empty predicate), (d) reuses the entire phase-32/38/39 stack, (e) needs no new crate/dependency/operator/`HttpFilterInstance` variant. One strong differential for ~5–7 tasks. It is the named future home ADR-0092/0094 deferred it to.

**Consequences.** No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only). The state-2 PLAN-write (`superpowers:writing-plans`) runs the §6.2 LOCAL reconnaissance against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` (an H1 listener + a file logger with `omit_empty_values: true`) and fires **ADR-0096** (reserved) with the locked facts. The KEY §6.2 risks: (1) the **"empty" predicate** — which value(s) Envoy drops (null / the `-` sentinel / empty string), for single-operator-typed vs mixed/literal values; (2) **recursive vs top-level-only** (nested-object/list drop; emptied-container drop); (3) the **text-format interaction**; (4) the **all-empty disposition** (`{}` vs omitted object). **ADR-0097 is reserved** for the §6.1 split (projected NOT to fire — ~150–350 LoC / ~5–7 tasks; fires only if §6.2 reveals the predicate/recursion/text-interaction is far gnarlier than projected). The new ROADMAP row `40` lands `in-progress` (depends-on `06 32 38 39`). Carry-forwards: `omit_empty_values` does not touch `rbac.rs`, so **M37-2/M37-1/M36-1/M36-2/M36-3/M34-*/M33-*** + the older Minors stay live; the phase-39 **M39-1** (mirror-enum sync), **M39-2** (unbounded recursion depth), and **CF-39-1** (numeric literals) stay live (M39-1/M39-2 are adjacent — the encoder IS phase 40's surface — and MAY be folded if the render-pass touches their site). No code changes this state-1 session. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds; no new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant projected (NO new `ConfigError` variant projected). **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0095** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 95; next-available **ADR-0096**, reserved for the §6.2 reconciliation). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. The state-2 PLAN-write is the next session.

## ADR-0096: Phase-40 §6.2 reconciliation — the `omit_empty_values` semantics EMPIRICALLY LOCKED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0`; **FIRES** with a MATERIAL divergence — `omit_empty_values` does NOT drop keys/entries (the SPEC's central "drop-empty pass" projection is VOID); it SWAPS the absent-operator `-` sentinel for the EMPTY STRING `""` in the command-operator MULTI-SEGMENT render, affecting BOTH `text_format` AND `json_format`, recursively; single-operator-typed values (→ `null`) are UNAFFECTED; NO new `ConfigError` variant; **ADR-0097 (the §6.1 split) does NOT fire**

**Status:** Accepted (phase-40 state-2 PLAN-write; `superpowers:writing-plans`). Consumes the **ADR-0096** number ADR-0095 reserved for the §6.2 reconciliation. Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0095 (the phase-40 pick + projected scope), ADR-0092/0094 (the phase-38/39 `json_format` encoder + the command-operator `-` sentinel rule), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal). **This ADR FIRES** — the reconnaissance overturns the SPEC's central projection (the SPEC §0/§2.1.2/§3.1 assumed `omit_empty_values` DROPS empty-valued keys; the truth is a sentinel SWAP); the PLAN is authored against the locked facts below.

**Context.** Phase-40 (`40-accesslog-omit-empty-values`) adds the `omit_empty_values` knob. ADR-0095/SPEC §3/§6.2 projected it as a "drop-empty render pass" but explicitly deferred the load-bearing "empty" semantics to this state-2 empirical reconnaissance. The reconnaissance stood up the pinned image `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` in Docker with an H1 listener + a `direct_response` route + a file access logger configured `log_format.omit_empty_values: true` (vs an absent-flag control), across five cases (json present/empty mix; json control; text format; nested+list; single-absent-only), scraping the log file.

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live v1.33.0; D-3.3).**

**§A — `omit_empty_values` does NOT DROP keys/entries. [DIVERGES — the SPEC's central "drop-empty pass" projection is VOID.]** CASE-1 (omit `true`) vs CASE-2 (omit absent/`false`) over the SAME 7-key `json_format` emitted ALL 7 keys in BOTH cases — `{"a_present_str":"GET","b_present_num":200,"c_absent_op":null,"d_absent_upstream":null,"e_mixed_absent":<…>,"f_empty_literal":"","g_literal":"lit"}`. NO key was dropped: the typed-`null` keys (`c_absent_op`/`d_absent_upstream` — single absent operators) survived as `null`; the empty-literal key (`f_empty_literal: ""`) survived as `""`. → The "omit" in `omit_empty_values` is NOT about omitting JSON KEYS; the keys always emit.

**§B — `omit_empty_values` SWAPS the absent-operator `-` sentinel for the EMPTY STRING `""` in the command-operator MULTI-SEGMENT render. [the real behavior; affects BOTH formats.]** The ONLY difference between CASE-1 (`true`) and CASE-2 (control) was the mixed/multi-segment key `e_mixed_absent: "pre-%REQ(X-ABSENT)%"`: control → `"pre--"` (literal `pre-` + the `-` sentinel for the absent op), omit `true` → `"pre-"` (literal `pre-` + the absent op rendered as `""`). CASE-3 confirmed the SAME for `text_format_source` (`"m=%REQ(:METHOD)% up=%UPSTREAM_HOST% x=%REQ(X-ABSENT)%"`): omit `true` → `m=GET up= x=` vs control `m=GET up=- x=-`. → `omit_empty_values` changes the command-operator engine's absent-`Option` substitution from the no-value sentinel `-` (the rule at `crates/envoy-accesslog/src/command_operator.rs:431` `render_value_segments`, the `.unwrap_or("-")` sites `:479`/`:486`/`:496`/`:508`) to the empty string `""`. It is a render-engine-level behavior shared by `text_format` and `json_format`.

**§C — single-operator-TYPED `json_format` values are UNAFFECTED. [the carve-out.]** A `json_format` value that is EXACTLY one operator routes through the typed encoder (`encode_single_op`: numeric→number, string→quoted, absent→`null`), NOT through `render_value_segments`. CASE-1 `c_absent_op`/`d_absent_upstream` (single absent ops) → `null` under BOTH omit and control; CASE-5 (`only_absent: "%REQ(X-ABSENT)%"`, omit `true`) → `{"only_absent":null}` (the key survives as `null`, NOT dropped, NOT `""`). → `encode_single_op` is UNCHANGED by `omit_empty_values`; the swap applies ONLY to the multi-segment/mixed `render_value_segments` path (the `Leaf` whose value is a literal-or-multi-operator string).

**§D — the swap applies RECURSIVELY (nested objects + lists). [CONFIRMED.]** CASE-4 (`omit: true`, `{nested:{mixed:"v=%REQ(X-ABSENT)%", single:"%REQ(X-ABSENT)%"}, arr:["a=%REQ(X-ABSENT)%","%REQ(X-ABSENT)%"]}`) → `{"arr":["a=",null],"nested":{"mixed":"v=","single":null}}`: the mixed values at depth (`nested.mixed`, `arr[0]`) got the `-`→`""` swap; the single-op values at depth (`nested.single`, `arr[1]`) stayed `null`. → The flag threads through the recursive `render_into` to every `Leaf`'s `render_value_segments`; the per-level/list structure is unchanged.

**§E — all-empty / config-validity. [CONFIRMED.]** A `json_format` of only single-absent ops → the keys survive as `null` (CASE-5 `{"only_absent":null}`), NOT dropped, NOT `{}`. `omit_empty_values: true` is a plain `bool` that boots fine alongside either arm (`text_format_source` or `json_format`); `deny_unknown_fields` rejects typos. → NO new `ConfigError` variant; the exactly-one-of validator + empty-top-map acceptance UNCHANGED.

**Decision.** Lock §A–§E. **Config model:** add `omit_empty_values: bool` (`#[serde(default)]`→`false`) to `SubstitutionFormatString` (`crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:704-709`; `deny_unknown_fields` + the exactly-one validator UNCHANGED; NO new `ConfigError` variant). **Engine:** thread an `omit_empty: bool` parameter into `render_value_segments` (`command_operator.rs:431`) so the absent-`Option` substitution is `if omit_empty { "" } else { "-" }` (the four `.unwrap_or("-")` sites become `.unwrap_or(empty_or_dash)`); `CompiledFormat::render` (text) and the `json_format` multi-segment leaf render (`encode_json_value`→`render_value_segments`, via the recursive `render_into`) pass the flag through. `encode_single_op` (the json typed-null/number/quoted path) is UNCHANGED (§C). The flag is carried on the compiled format (a field on `CompiledFormat`/`CompiledJsonFormat`/`LogFormat` set at construction, OR a `render(record, omit_empty)` parameter — a PLAN factoring call). **Fixture `0048-accesslog-omit-empty`** demonstrates the SENTINEL SWAP (a `json_format` and/or `text_format` with mixed/multi-segment absent-operator values + `omit_empty_values: true` → the `-` becomes `""`, byte-exact) + a flag-off control (the `-` sentinel). The in-process backstop carries the text path, the recursive swap (§D), the single-op carve-out (§C), and the default-off round-trip.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0097 stays UNFIRED).** The change is a ONE-bool config field + a ONE-parameter thread into the EXISTING `render_value_segments` (4 `.unwrap_or` sites) + flag-passing through the text/json render entry points — SMALLER than the SPEC's projected "drop-empty pass" (no key-filtering logic). Estimate **~120–250 LoC / ~5–6 TDD tasks** — well under the §6.1 gate. **ADR-0097 stays available** for a future split trigger.

**Scope correction (supersedes the §0/§2.1.2/§3.1 "drop-empty" framing of ADR-0095/SPEC).** IN this phase: the `omit_empty_values: bool` config field; the `-`→`""` sentinel swap in `render_value_segments` for BOTH text + json multi-segment values, recursively (§B/§D); the single-op carve-out (§C, no code — `encode_single_op` untouched); default-off byte-preservation. The §2.2 deferrals (`sort_properties`, `content_type`, CF-39-1, the deprecated scalars, the other Observability surfaces) are UNCHANGED. The SPEC's "drop empty KEYS" language is VOID — `omit_empty_values` is a sentinel swap, not a key filter.

**Consequences.** `PLAN.md` is authored against §A–§E inline (no projections). The `text_format` interaction is IN scope (§B — the same swap; the SPEC §2.2 "deferred if heavy" clause is moot since it is the SAME one-parameter change). NO new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`HttpFilterInstance` variant; NO new `ConfigError` variant. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds. Carry-forwards: the phase-39 **M39-1/M39-2** + **CF-39-1** stay live (M39-1/M39-2 ADJACENT — the `json_format` encoder is touched; MAY be folded if cheap); **M38-2/M38-1** + the RBAC/older Minors stay live. **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0096** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 96; next-available **ADR-0097**, RESERVED for the §6.1 split which this ADR confirms does NOT fire). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs.** The state-3 implementation is the next session.
