## ADR-0104: Phase-47 pick + scope — **differentially witness the failure-path `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` string `route_not_found` byte-exact on the HOST-miss (no-matching-virtual_host) 404 path** via a NEW access-log fixture `0055`, SETTING `Some("route_not_found")` at envoy-rust's H1 no-matching-virtual_host `synth_404` arm (`hcm.rs:1535`; the detail is `None` today) — **CONSUMING carry-forward M46-1** (the host-miss 404 detail phase 46 deferred); NO new `Op` / `AccessLogRecord` field / crate / dependency / fuzz-target / `ConfigError` variant; choose the host-miss `route_not_found` over the rejected alternatives below + fixture `0055`

**Status:** Accepted (phase-47 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `47-accesslog-rcd-host-not-found`. **Consumes the ADR-0104 number** that ADR-0103 reserved for the phase-46 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 46 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0104` is the next-free number (the reclaim-a-lapsed-reservation convention by which ADR-0103 reclaimed the phase-45 split slot, ADR-0102 the phase-44, ADR-0101 the phase-43). Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0103 (the phase-46 ROUTE-miss `route_not_found` witness + the synth-404-arm `Some(detail)` pattern; this phase closes the host-miss arm M46-1 it deferred), ADR-0099 (the phase-42 `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` operator + field), the phase-46 fixture `0054` (the route-miss template).

**Context.** Phase 46 (ADR-0103) set `Some("route_not_found")` at the no-matching-ROUTE `synth_404` arm (`hcm.rs:1553`) + witnessed it via fixture `0054`, but DEFERRED the no-matching-VIRTUAL_HOST arm (`hcm.rs:1535`, carry-forward M46-1) because its v1.33.0 detail string was not cleanly captured at phase-46 state-1 and `0054`'s `domains:["*"]` wildcard vhost never exercised it. envoy-rust's host-miss arm still emits `BuildOutcome::Synth(synth_404(close), None)` → renders `null`, diverging from Envoy. This phase closes M46-1 — the cheapest available pick that closes an owed carry-forward.

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` + the source; D-3.3).**

**§A — Envoy's host-miss 404 emits the SAME clean deterministic `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS% = route_not_found`.** The state-1 recon booted Envoy v1.33.0 with a `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` access-log + a vhost `domains:["match.test"]`, probed with `Host: unknown.test` (matches NO domain) → `{RCD=route_not_found, RC=404, RF=NR}` — a brace-free / OS-independent / DETERMINISTIC constant, identical to the route-miss case.

**§B — the host-miss trigger is WIRABLE with the existing driver, NO harness change (spec-review-confirmed).** The `Http1AccessLogByteExact` driver (`tests/differential/src/lib.rs:5106-5131`) passes the probe `host:` verbatim → `drive_http1` writes `Host: {host}\r\n` literally (`lib.rs:2015-2020`); `vh_matches` (`hcm.rs:1594-1602`, exact case-insensitive + `*` wildcard) returns `false` for a non-matching domain → `vh = None` → the `:1535` arm. The probe Host MUST be NON-EMPTY (the codec rejects missing/empty Host with `synth_400` at `~:1502-1512` before the vhost-walk; a non-empty `nomatch.test` sails past to `:1535`).

**§C — envoy-rust emits the access-log line on the host-miss path; the ONLY `src/` change is the detail.** Same flow as the route-miss arm phase 46 proved: the writer-arm (`:864-866`) threads the `BuildOutcome::Synth` detail → `response_code_details_for_log`; the record is built unconditionally (`:1247`). Changing `None` → `Some("route_not_found")` at `:1535` makes the host-miss 404 line carry the detail. NO change to the 404 status/body/headers/flags. NO new `Op`/`AccessLogRecord` field/crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`ConfigError` variant.

**§D — additive / byte-preserving.** All five existing rcd-logging fixtures (`0050`-`0054`) use `domains:["*"]` wildcard vhosts with a matching probe Host → none triggers a host-miss, so setting the previously-`None` host-miss detail changes ZERO existing-fixture bytes → all `0001`-`0054` stay byte-identical.

**Decision.** Phase 47 = `47-accesslog-rcd-host-not-found`: set `Some("route_not_found")` at the H1 no-matching-virtual_host `synth_404` arm (`hcm.rs:1535`) + differentially witness it byte-exact via fixture `0055-accesslog-rcd-host-not-found` (a `direct_response`/`clusters:[]` listener from the `0054` template, a vhost `domains:["match.test"]` [NON-wildcard] + a catch-all route, a `json_format` logging `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%`/`rcd` + `%RESPONSE_CODE%`/`%REQ(:METHOD)%`/`%PROTOCOL%` anchors, the `http1_access_log_byte_exact` driver, a `host: nomatch.test` probe with `expected_status: 404`) + the differential test `access_log_rcd_host_not_found.rs` + an in-process backstop + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT row update. **M46-1 CONSUMED.** Load-bearing invariant: additive — all `0001`-`0054` stay byte-identical.

**Rejected / deferred alternatives.** (1) **connect-failure / overflow details** — non-deterministic OS-brace + the connect-fail 502-vs-503 status divergence; deferred **M45-2**. (2) **H2 host-miss/route-miss details** — needs an H2 access-log differential driver (a harness-building phase); deferred **M45-1**. (3) **another not-yet-witnessed access-log operator** — viable but the host-miss is the cheapest path to closing an owed carry-forward (M46-1). (4) **gRPC ALS / OTLP / tap** — heavy infra. The host-miss `route_not_found` is the cheapest-STRONG VALID pick — a recon-confirmed clean constant, a one-token `src/` change, the simplest fixture (a non-wildcard vhost + a non-matching Host), closing the owed M46-1.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0105 stays UNFIRED).** One set-site (`:1535`) + a `direct_response` fixture (`0055`) + a differential test + an in-process backstop + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT update. **~30-100 LoC / ~3-5 tasks** — well under the §6.1 gate. **ADR-0105 reserved** (projected NOT to fire).

**Consequences.** No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only); the SPEC was spec-reviewed by a fresh subagent → **✅ APPROVED, 0 Critical / 0 Important / 3 Minor** (the biggest risk — the harness probe-Host wiring — DEFINITIVELY DISPROVED: the driver passes the Host verbatim, no harness change needed; the 3 Minors are resolved-now confirmations, folded into §3). ## ADR-0103: Phase-46 pick + scope — **differentially witness the failure-path `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` string `route_not_found` byte-exact on the route-miss 404 path** via a NEW access-log fixture `0054`, SETTING `Some("route_not_found")` at envoy-rust's H1 no-matching-route `synth_404` arm (`hcm.rs:1553`; the detail is `None` today) — the SECOND clean failure-path detail (after phase 45's `no_healthy_upstream`), continuing carry-forward M42-1; NO new `Op` / `AccessLogRecord` field / crate / dependency / fuzz-target / `ConfigError` variant; choose `route_not_found` over the rejected alternatives below + fixture `0054`

**Status:** Accepted (phase-46 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `46-accesslog-rcd-route-not-found`. **Consumes the ADR-0103 number** that ADR-0102 reserved for the phase-45 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 45 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0103` is the next-free number (the reclaim-a-lapsed-reservation convention by which ADR-0102 reclaimed the phase-44 split slot, ADR-0101 the phase-43, ADR-0100 the phase-42). Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0099 (the phase-42 `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` operator + `AccessLogRecord.response_code_details` field), ADR-0102 (the phase-45 first failure-path detail `no_healthy_upstream` + the synth-arm `Some(detail)` pattern), the phase-42 fixture `0050` (the `direct_response` access-log template, no upstream).

**Context.** Phase 45 (ADR-0102) witnessed the FIRST failure-path `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` value — `no_healthy_upstream` — by setting `Some(...)` at the H1 no-healthy synth arm. Every OTHER failure path still renders `-`/`null`. The next-cheapest-STRONG clean deterministic failure detail is **`route_not_found`**: a request whose path matches a virtual_host but NO route within it → Envoy 404 + `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS% = route_not_found`. envoy-rust's H1 route-walk already returns a byte-matching 404 via `synth_404` (`hcm.rs:1553` "no matching route") but emits `BuildOutcome::Synth(synth_404(close), None)` → renders `null` today. This continues the M42-1 failure-path vocabulary with the cheapest available clean witness.

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` + the source; D-3.3).**

**§A — Envoy's route-miss 404 emits a CLEAN deterministic `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS% = route_not_found`.** The state-1 recon booted Envoy v1.33.0 with a `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` access-log and a vhost `domains: ["match.test"]` with a single `prefix: "/specific"` route, then probed `match.test` `/nomatch` → `{"rc":404,"rcd":"route_not_found","rf":"NR"}` — a BRACE-FREE / OS-independent / DETERMINISTIC constant.

**§B — envoy-rust already returns a byte-matching 404; the ONLY `src/` change is the detail.** The H1 route-walk's no-matching-route arm (`hcm.rs:1553`) returns `BuildOutcome::Synth(synth_404(close), None)`; the writer-arm (`hcm.rs:864-866`) threads the `BuildOutcome::Synth` detail to `response_code_details_for_log` (the phase-42 widening, exactly like `direct_response`/`via_upstream`), and the record is built unconditionally below the match (`hcm.rs:1247`). So changing `None` → `Some("route_not_found")` at `:1553` makes the 404 access-log line carry the detail. NO change to the 404 status/body/headers/flags. NO new `Op`/`AccessLogRecord` field/crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`ConfigError` variant.

**§C — scope ONLY the no-matching-ROUTE arm (`:1553`), NOT the host-miss arm (`:1535`) [the spec-review I-1 fix].** envoy-rust has TWO `synth_404` sites: no-matching-virtual_host (`:1535`) + no-matching-route (`:1553`). The fixture `0054` uses a `domains: ["*"]` wildcard vhost (Host always matches), so ONLY the route-miss arm is exercised + witnessed. Setting the host-miss arm would be unwitnessed + unbacked (its v1.33.0 detail was not cleanly captured at state-1). The host-miss `route_not_found` is **deferred as carry-forward M46-1** (a future phase after a clean recon).

**§D — additive / byte-preserving.** Fixtures `0050`-`0053` log `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` but none probe a 404 route-miss (`0050` direct_response-200, `0051` cluster, `0052` upstream_host, `0053` no-healthy-503), so setting the previously-`None` route-miss detail changes ZERO existing-fixture bytes → all `0001`-`0053` stay byte-identical.

**Decision.** Phase 46 = `46-accesslog-rcd-route-not-found`: set `Some("route_not_found")` at the H1 no-matching-route `synth_404` arm (`hcm.rs:1553`) + differentially witness it byte-exact via fixture `0054-accesslog-rcd-route-not-found` (a `direct_response` listener — the `0050` template, no upstream — with a `domains: ["*"]` vhost + a single `prefix: "/specific"` route, an access-log `json_format` logging `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%`/`rcd` + `%RESPONSE_CODE%`/`%REQ(:METHOD)%`/`%PROTOCOL%` anchors, the `http1_access_log_byte_exact` cross-proxy-equality driver, a `/nomatch` probe with `expected_status: 404`) + the differential test `access_log_rcd_route_not_found.rs` + an in-process backstop + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` row update. Load-bearing invariant: additive — all `0001`-`0053` stay byte-identical.

**Rejected / deferred alternatives.** (1) **The host-miss 404 detail** — deferred **M46-1** (unwitnessed by `0054`; unverified at state-1). (2) **connect-failure / overflow details** — non-deterministic OS-brace content + the connect-fail 502-vs-503 status divergence; deferred **M45-2**. (3) **H2 failure-path details** — needs an H2 access-log differential driver (a harness-building phase); deferred **M45-1**. (4) **`%UPSTREAM_HOST%` on H2** — same H2-driver dependency. (5) **gRPC ALS / OTLP / tap** — heavy infra. `route_not_found` is the cheapest-STRONG VALID pick — a clean recon-confirmed constant, envoy-rust already 404s, the simplest trigger yet (a route table, no subset/backend), continuing the owed M42-1 failure-path gap.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0104 stays UNFIRED).** One set-site (`:1553`) + a `direct_response` fixture (`0054`) + a differential test + an in-process backstop + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT update. **~40-120 LoC / ~3-5 tasks** — well under the §6.1 gate. **ADR-0104 reserved** (projected NOT to fire).

**Consequences.** No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only); the SPEC was spec-reviewed by a fresh subagent → **I-1** (don't set the unwitnessed host-miss arm) folded by scoping §A to the route-miss arm only + the host-miss → M46-1; Minors (line refs, json-number note, item-3-resolved) folded. The state-2 PLAN-write (`superpowers:writing-plans`) runs the §6.2 recon (the `0054` trigger wiring from `0050`; the exact `:1553` set-site; the fuzz SKIP) and authors `PLAN.md`; **ADR-0103 needs NO §6.2-reconciliation ADR** unless the recon overturns a §A-§D fact. The new ROADMAP row `46` lands `in-progress` (depends-on `06 32 42`). Carry-forwards: this phase CONTINUES the failure-path slice of **M42-1** (witnesses `route_not_found`) + ADDS **M46-1** (host-miss 404 detail); **M45-1/M45-2 + M40-1/M39-1/M39-2/M38-1/M38-2 + CF-39-1** + older stay live. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds; no new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`ConfigError` variant projected. **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0103** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 103; next-available **ADR-0104**, reserved for the §6.1 split). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. ## ADR-0102: Phase-45 pick + scope — **differentially witness the FIRST failure-path `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` string `no_healthy_upstream` byte-exact on the no-healthy-upstream 503 path** (a `metadata_match` NO_FALLBACK subset-miss trigger) via a NEW access-log fixture `0053`, SETTING `Some("no_healthy_upstream")` at envoy-rust's H1 no-healthy synth arm (the detail is `None` today) — opening the failure-path slice of carry-forward M42-1; NO new `Op` / `AccessLogRecord` field / crate / dependency / fuzz-target / `ConfigError` variant; choose `no_healthy_upstream` over the rejected alternatives below + fixture `0053`

**Status:** Accepted (phase-45 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `45-accesslog-rcd-no-healthy`. **Consumes the ADR-0102 number** that ADR-0101 reserved for the phase-44 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 44 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0102` is the next-free number (the reclaim-a-lapsed-reservation convention by which ADR-0101 reclaimed the phase-43 split slot, ADR-0100 the phase-42, ADR-0099 the phase-41). Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0099 (the phase-42 `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` operator + `AccessLogRecord.response_code_details` field), ADR-0100/0101 (the phase-43/44 proxy access-log fixtures `0051`/`0052` + the `http1_access_log_byte_exact` driver), ADR-0074 (the phase-30 `lb_subset_config` NO_FALLBACK subset machinery, fixture `0038`), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal).

**Context.** Phase 42 (ADR-0099) added `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` (`AccessLogRecord.response_code_details: Option<String>`) but witnessed ONLY the two SUCCESS-path values — `direct_response` (fixture 0050) and `via_upstream` (the H1 proxy-success arm `hcm.rs:995`). Every FAILURE path leaves `response_code_details_for_log = None` → envoy-rust renders `-`/`null` for `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` on the no-healthy synth-503 (`hcm.rs:431-438`), the connect-failure synth-502 (`:528`), the overflow synth-503 (`:506-513`), while Envoy emits a specific string. Carry-forward **M42-1** (the failure-path vocabulary — ADVANCED but NOT closed by phase 43) is the strongest owed access-log gap. The phase-44 STATE close-out candidate menu LED with M42-1's failure-path vocabulary as the meatier-but-strongest next pick.

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` + the source; D-3.3).**

**§A — Envoy's no-healthy-upstream 503 emits a CLEAN deterministic `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS% = no_healthy_upstream`.** The state-1 recon booted Envoy v1.33.0 with a `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` access-log and drove the no-healthy 503 two ways: (i) an empty-endpoints cluster → `{"rc":503,"rcd":"no_healthy_upstream","rf":"UH"}`; (ii) a `metadata_match` NO_FALLBACK subset-miss (the fixture-0038 `/nope` pattern) → IDENTICALLY `{"rc":503,"rcd":"no_healthy_upstream","rf":"UH"}`. The string is BRACE-FREE / OS-independent / DETERMINISTIC — a clean byte-exact witness.

**§B — by CONTRAST the connect-failure / overflow details are NON-DETERMINISTIC (rejected).** The connect-failure path (dead port) emits `upstream_reset_before_response_started{remote_connection_failure|delayed_connect_error:_Connection_refused}` — a brace sub-detail carrying an OS-derived error phrase (and Envoy returns 503/UF here while envoy-rust's connect-fail arm synthesizes 502 — a separate divergence). Such brace content is not byte-exact cross-proxy → those dispositions are deferred (M45-2).

**§C — the no-healthy trigger MUST be the NO_FALLBACK subset-miss, NOT empty-endpoints.** An empty-endpoints STATIC cluster (`load_assignment.endpoints: []`) is BOOT-FATAL in envoy-rust (`ConfigError::EmptyClusterEndpoints`, `crates/envoy-config/src/bootstrap.rs:3193`) — it can never go green. The workable trigger is a STATIC cluster with a NON-EMPTY endpoint set + `lb_subset_config { fallback_policy: NO_FALLBACK, subset_selectors: [{ keys: [stage] }] }` and a route `metadata_match` selecting a non-existent subset (fixture `0038`'s proven `/nope` shape) → `subset → Eligible::None → pick_endpoint → None → synth_no_healthy_upstream` (503 + `no healthy upstream` body, byte-matching Envoy). The state-1 recon re-confirmed Envoy emits `no_healthy_upstream` on THIS trigger (the spec-review C1/I1 fix).

**§D — the scope is a SMALL code change + a NEW fixture.** envoy-rust's H1 no-healthy arm already returns a byte-matching 503 + body, and the access-log record is built unconditionally below the writer-arm match (`hcm.rs:1243`), so the line is observable. The ONLY `src/` change is threading `Some("no_healthy_upstream")` to `response_code_details_for_log` on the `endpoint: None` no-healthy path (PLAN-VERIFY the seam: an `Option<&'static str>` on `AttemptResult`, or detecting `attempt.endpoint.is_none()` at the `BuildOutcome::Proxy` arm). NO change to the 503 status / body / headers / flags. NO new `Op` / `AccessLogRecord` field / crate / dependency / fuzz-target / `ConfigError` variant (`%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` + the field exist since phase 42).

**Decision.** Phase 45 = `45-accesslog-rcd-no-healthy`: set `Some("no_healthy_upstream")` at the H1 no-healthy synth arm + differentially witness it byte-exact via fixture `0053-accesslog-rcd-no-healthy` (a NO_FALLBACK subset-miss cluster + an access-log `json_format` logging `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%`/`rcd` + `%RESPONSE_CODE%`/`%REQ(:METHOD)%`/`%PROTOCOL%` anchors; the existing `http1_access_log_byte_exact` cross-proxy-equality driver) + the differential test `access_log_rcd_no_healthy.rs` + an in-process backstop + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` row update (the no-healthy failure path now witnessed). Load-bearing invariant: additive — all `0001`-`0052` stay byte-identical (no existing no-healthy access-log fixture).

**Rejected / deferred alternatives.** (1) **connect-failure / overflow detail strings** — non-deterministic brace content (§B); deferred as **M45-2**. (2) **H2 no-healthy detail** — the H2 no-healthy arm returns 502 (not 503; `crates/envoy-http2/src/hcm.rs:187`, an independent codec path with no shared synth helper) AND there is NO H2 access-log differential driver, so it cannot be witnessed this phase; deferred as **M45-1** (H2 failure-path details + an H2 access-log differential driver). (3) **`%UPSTREAM_HOST%` on H2** — needs a new H2 access-log byte-exact differential driver (a harness-building phase), heavier than this; deferred. (4) **another not-yet-witnessed success-path operator** — weaker than closing the owed M42-1 failure-path gap. (5) **gRPC ALS / OTLP / tracing / tap** — new sink/transport infrastructure, far heavier. `no_healthy_upstream` is the cheapest-STRONG VALID pick — it closes the FIRST slice of a genuine owed gap (the failure-path detail vocabulary) for ~one set-site + one fixture, with a recon-confirmed deterministic string.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0103 stays UNFIRED).** One set-site + a NO_FALLBACK-subset fixture (`0053`) + a differential test + an in-process backstop + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT update. **~60–150 LoC / ~3–5 tasks** — well under the §6.1 gate. **ADR-0103 reserved** (projected NOT to fire).

**Consequences.** No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only); the SPEC was spec-reviewed by a fresh subagent → **C1** (empty-endpoints boot-fatal) + **I1** (re-confirm the string on the workable trigger) folded via a re-run live recon (the NO_FALLBACK subset-miss emits `no_healthy_upstream`); Minors noted. The state-2 PLAN-write (`superpowers:writing-plans`) runs the §6.2 recon (PLAN-VERIFY: the subset-miss wiring transcription from `0038`; the H1 detail threading seam; the fuzz-coverage SKIP) and authors `PLAN.md`; **ADR-0102 needs NO §6.2-reconciliation ADR** unless the recon overturns a §A-§D fact (the feasibility is recon- + code-verified). The new ROADMAP row `45` lands `in-progress` (depends-on `06 30 32 42`). Carry-forwards: this phase OPENS the failure-path slice of **M42-1** (witnesses `no_healthy_upstream`) but does NOT fully close it (connect/overflow details = **M45-2**; H2 failure details + driver = **M45-1**); **M40-1/M39-1/M39-2/M38-1/M38-2 + CF-39-1** + the RBAC/older Minors stay live. `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` holds; no new crate/dependency/fuzz-target/`ConfigError` variant projected. **DECISIONS.md ledger head: ADR-0102** (this ADR; project-cumulative count 102; next-available **ADR-0103**, reserved for the §6.1 split). **ADR-0014 REMAINS IN FORCE; ADR-0028 REMAINS OPEN; ADR-0049 governs** the config-validity all-fatal posture. ## ADR-0101: Phase-44 pick + scope — **differentially witness the `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` access-log command operator byte-exact on a real upstream** (the gap fixture `0051` excluded) via a NEW proxy access-log fixture `0052` that routes through a `{{BACKEND_IP}}` shared-host-LAN-IP STATIC cluster, so BOTH proxies dial the IDENTICAL `<host-LAN-IP>:<port>` and render the IDENTICAL `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` line (asserted cross-proxy-equal by the existing `http1_access_log_byte_exact` driver) — adding NO new `Op` / record field / connection plumbing (`%UPSTREAM_HOST%` has been implemented since phase 06), with at most a small `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` rendering-format fix if envoy-rust's `endpoint.to_string()` differs from Envoy's `<ip>:<port>` (PLAN-VERIFY); choose `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` byte-exact over the rejected alternatives below + fixture `0052`

**Status:** Accepted (phase-44 state-1 brainstorm; `superpowers:brainstorming`). Locks the pick + minimum-viable scope for phase `44-accesslog-upstream-host`. **Consumes the ADR-0101 number** that ADR-0100 reserved for the phase-43 §6.1 split — that split did NOT fire and phase 43 is closed, so the reservation lapsed and `0101` is the next-free number (the reclaim-a-lapsed-reservation convention by which ADR-0100 reclaimed the phase-42 split slot, ADR-0099 the phase-41, ADR-0097 the phase-40). Supersedes nothing. Builds on ADR-0078/0079 (the phase-32 command-operator engine), the phase-06 `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` implementation, ADR-0100 (the phase-43 first proxy access-log fixture `0051` + the marker-driven-`Http1EchoBackend` reuse), ADR-0049 (config-validity all-fatal).

**Context.** Phase 43 stood up the FIRST proxy (upstream-routed) access-log differential fixture (`0051`) + proved the marker-driven-backend reuse pattern (ZERO new harness code), but it DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED the `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` token from its byte-exact assertion because its `{{BACKEND_HOST}}`/STRICT_DNS backend resolves to DIFFERENT addresses per-side (host-gateway IP on the Envoy-container side vs `127.0.0.1` on the envoy-rust-host subject — structurally non-byte-identical). So `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` — IMPLEMENTED since phase 06 (`AccessLogRecord.upstream_host: Option<String>` set at the HCM proxy-success arm `hcm.rs:994` to `endpoint.to_string()`) — has NEVER been verified against upstream Envoy on a real upstream. The next-phase pick weighs the cheapest-strong leaf; the phase-43 STATE close-out candidate menu LED with `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` byte-exact (cheap given the `0051` template + the shared-IP mechanism).

**Findings (each EMPIRICALLY OBSERVED against live `envoyproxy/envoy:v1.33.0` + the harness source; D-3.3).**

**§A — Envoy's `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` renders the resolved endpoint `<ip>:<port>`.** A request routed to a STATIC cluster `127.0.0.1:13099` → `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` = `127.0.0.1:13099` (json single-op → `"127.0.0.1:13099"`). (The `127.0.0.1:13099` is the LOCAL recon address — illustrative of the RENDER FORMAT only; the fixture uses `{{BACKEND_IP}}`, never loopback.) envoy-rust sets `upstream_host_for_log = Some(endpoint.to_string())` — PLAN-VERIFY the two byte-match; if they differ (IPv6 bracketing, a trailing component), a small `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` format fix is in scope.

**§B — the `{{BACKEND_IP}}` shared-host-LAN-IP mechanism makes `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` byte-identical cross-proxy [the feasibility basis].** Confirmed by code-read: `run_fixture` (`tests/differential/src/lib.rs:3011-3013`) resolves `{{BACKEND_IP}}` to ONE shared host-LAN-IP via `discover_host_lan_ip()` for BOTH sides (GLOBAL in `run_fixture`, before the `Driver` dispatch — not driver-specific), and `{{HTTP1_BACKEND_PORT}}` to the backend's actual port (identical both sides). So a `{{BACKEND_IP}}` STATIC cluster → both proxies dial `<host-LAN-IP>:<port>` → both render `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` = `<host-LAN-IP>:<port>`, BYTE-IDENTICAL. The value is DYNAMIC per CI run but SHARED, and the `http1_access_log_byte_exact` driver asserts cross-proxy EQUALITY (`assert_access_log_lines_byte_identical`, `access_log.rs:305`), NOT against a static literal — so the dynamic-but-shared address passes. The LB fixtures `0036`/`0037`/`0038` already use `{{BACKEND_IP}}` STATIC clusters (the precedent).

**§C — the scope is a NEW fixture (mostly), NOT a new operator.** `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` already exists (phase 06); this phase WITNESSES it. The deliverable is fixture `0052-accesslog-upstream-host` (a `{{BACKEND_IP}}` STATIC cluster from `0036`/`0037` + the access-log format/`http1_access_log_byte_exact` driver from `0051`, logging `%UPSTREAM_HOST%`), asserting cross-proxy equality. NO new `Op` / `AccessLogRecord` field / connection plumbing / crate / dependency / fuzz-target / `ConfigError` variant. The ONLY possible `src/` change is a `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` rendering-format fix (PLAN-VERIFY §A — projected none). The proxy access-log harness needs ZERO new code (the `0051`-proven marker-driven reuse).

**Decision.** Phase 44 = `44-accesslog-upstream-host`: differentially witness `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` byte-exact via a `{{BACKEND_IP}}` shared-IP proxy access-log fixture `0052`. **Implementation:** author fixture `0052` (clone the access-log format/driver from `0051`; take the STATIC `{{BACKEND_IP}}` cluster from `0036`/`0037` — do NOT clone `0051`'s STRICT_DNS cluster); PLAN-VERIFY the `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` format-match (fix envoy-rust's rendering only if it diverges); update the BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` row ("differentially witnessed by `0052`"); add a `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` fuzz seed only if not already in the corpus.

**Rejected alternatives.** (1) **M42-1's `%RESPONSE_CODE_DETAILS%` failure-path vocabulary** (connect-error/reset/503 details) — STRONGER (new detail strings, closes M42-1) but needs a FAILURE-INJECTION proxy fixture (a backend that refuses/resets) + envoy-rust code for the failure-path detail strings — a bigger phase; deferred to its own future phase. (2) **`%REQUEST_HEADERS_BYTES%`** — a header-byte COUNT (formula-match rabbit hole; prior-flagged "fragile"). (3) **`%ACCESS_LOG_TYPE%`** — near-constant (`DownstreamEnd` — weak). (4) **CF-39-1 numeric-literal leaves / `sort_properties`** — empty-differential risk. (5) **gRPC ALS / OTLP / tracing / tap** — new sink/transport infrastructure, far heavier. `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` byte-exact is the cheapest-STRONG VALID pick — it closes a GENUINE correctness gap (an already-shipped operator UNVERIFIED on a real upstream) for ~one fixture, reusing the `0051` + `{{BACKEND_IP}}` machinery, and may surface a real format mismatch.

**§6.1 split — does NOT fire (ADR-0102 stays UNFIRED).** A NEW fixture (`0052`) + at most a small `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` format fix + a BEHAVIOR_CONTRACT update + a possible fuzz seed. **~50–150 LoC / ~3–5 tasks** — well under the §6.1 gate. **ADR-0102 reserved** (projected NOT to fire).

**Consequences.** No code changes this state-1 session (SPEC + ADR + ROADMAP + STATE only). The state-2 PLAN-write (`superpowers:writing-plans`) runs the §6.2 recon (the `%UPSTREAM_HOST%` format-match envoy-rust vs Envoy; the `0052` `{{BACKEND_IP}}` wiring) and authors `PLAN.md`; **ADR-0101 needs NO §6.2-reconciliation ADR** unless the recon overturns a §A-§C fact (the feasibility basis is already code-verified).
